qa.en: Die maintenance is scheduled by shot count, and burr height is checked at first article and at defined intervals during the run.
qa.zh: 模具保養照沖次排，毛邊高度首件要量，量產中也照規定間隔量。

qa.en: The burr height must not exceed 0.1 mm.
qa.zh: 毛邊高度不可超過 0.1 mm。

words.definition: to break open suddenly because of pressure.

general.en: The pipe burst due to high pressure, causing water damage.
general.zh: 水管因高壓而爆裂，造成水損。

general.en: A pipe under the sink burst on Tuesday night. Water went everywhere.
general.zh: 星期二晚上水槽下面的水管爆了。水噴得到處都是。

words.definition: A more expensive and comfortable class of travel on a plane, train, etc.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: I'd like a single business class ticket.
general.zh: 我想要一張單程商務艙機票。

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I would like to fly to Japan in business class.
general.zh: 如果我有一千美金，我想要搭商務艙去日本。

general.en: Sure. And if you'd like more space, business class is only fifteen euros more today.
general.zh: 沒問題。另外如果你想要寬敞一點，今天升等商務艙只要多十五歐元。

general.en: Fifteen? I'd be silly to say no. Business class, then.
general.zh: 十五？不加就太傻了。那就商務艙吧。

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I like fly to Japan in business class because I like lying down on fully flat seats.
general.zh: 文法不完整（like fly）。

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I would like to fly to Japan in business class because I like lying down on fully flat seats.
general.zh: 如果我有一千美元，我想搭商務艙飛日本，因為我喜歡躺在全平躺座椅上。

words.definition: Full of people moving about busily and noisily.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。

general.en: What is your hometown like? — My hometown is lively and bustling. It is famous for its night market.
general.zh: 你的家鄉是什麼樣的地方？——我的家鄉熱鬧繁華，以夜市聞名。（⚠️ 必須直接用「形容詞」與「地方特徵」回答，絕對不可以用 "it is like…"！Bustling 指一個地方非常忙碌，充滿活動、人群與能量。）

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively. Though it can get crowded, many people still enjoy visiting because it makes them feel connected to their community.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。雖然可能會變得很擁擠，許多人仍然喜歡造訪，因為這讓他們感到與社區有所連結。

words.definition: The inside of a plane where passengers sit.

general.en: You can take a carry-on bag into the cabin.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李進客艙。

general.en: Got it. Could I have a blanket after takeoff? It's a bit cold in the cabin.
general.zh: 了解。起飛後可以給我一條毯子嗎？客艙裡有點冷。

general.en: A loose cable inside the machine can cause a strange noise.
general.zh: 機器裡鬆脫的線材可能會造成怪聲音。

general.en: He managed to connect his Apple laptop to the TV using an HDMI cable.
general.zh: 他設法用 HDMI 線把他的 Apple 筆電接上電視。

general.en: He wanted to connect his laptop to the TV using an HDMI cable.
general.zh: 他想用 HDMI 線把筆電接到電視上。

general.en: He wanted to use an HDMI cable to show his PowerPoint presentation.
general.zh: 他想用 HDMI 線進行 PowerPoint 簡報。

general.en: Please secure the cable with a tie before closing the cover.
general.zh: 蓋上外蓋之前，請用束帶把線材固定好。

general.en: I took the cable car.

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: On the first day, I visited Ba Na Mountains and took the cable car.
general.zh: 第一天我去了巴拿山，搭了纜車。

general.en: I took the cable car.
general.zh: 我搭了纜車。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: We use cable ties to keep the wiring neat.
general.zh: 我們用束帶讓配線保持整齊。

general.en: Install the electronic cables and secure them with cable ties. Then, we trim off the excess.
general.zh: 安裝電子線並用束帶固定。然後剪掉多餘的部分。

general.en: We need to ensure the testing equipment is calibrated properly.
general.zh: 我們必須確保測試設備有被妥善校準。（in the correct way）

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Every gauge is calibrated. The label shows the next due date.
qa.zh: 每支量具都有校驗，標籤上有下次到期日。

qa.en: Measuring instruments are calibrated at defined intervals with results traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 量測儀器照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: Calibration intervals are defined by instrument type and usage frequency, and all results are traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 校驗週期看儀器種類跟用多頻繁，結果都可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: Operators use go/no-go gauges and calipers on the line; QA uses micrometers and height gauges for the patrol check. Every tool is zeroed before use and included in the calibration system.
qa.zh: 作業員在線上用通止規跟卡尺；品保巡檢用分厘卡跟高度規。每支量具用之前先歸零，全部都在校驗系統裡。

qa.en: Yes. I will send the inspection report with the actual measured values for each characteristic, together with the lot number and the calibration status of the instruments used.
qa.zh: 可以。我會把檢驗報告寄過去，每個特性都有實測值，也會附批號跟用到的儀器校驗狀態。

qa.en: The auditor asked for the calibration certificates.
qa.zh: 稽核員要求提供校驗證書。

general.en: And the practical task? I saw a caliper and a test piece on the table.
general.zh: 那實作任務呢？我看到桌上有卡尺和一個測試件。

qa.en: Calipers, micrometers, height gauges, feeler gauges, and thread gauges used for routine in-process checks.
qa.zh: 卡尺、分厘卡、高度規、厚薄規、螺紋規這些，製程中例行檢查用的量具。

qa.en: We use a caliper to check this dimension.
qa.zh: 這個尺寸我們用卡尺量。

qa.en: We measure it with a caliper at three points and take the average.
qa.zh: 我們用卡尺量三點取平均。

qa.en: The GR&R for this caliper check came out at 27%, above the 10% acceptance limit. The measurement system needs improvement before we can trust the data.
qa.zh: 這項卡尺量測的 GR&R 是 27%，超過 10% 的允收上限。量測系統要先改善，數據才能信。

qa.en: Operators use go/no-go gauges and calipers on the line; QA uses micrometers and height gauges for the patrol check. Every tool is zeroed before use and included in the calibration system.
qa.zh: 作業員在線上用通止規跟卡尺；品保巡檢用分厘卡跟高度規。每支量具用之前先歸零，全部都在校驗系統裡。

qa.en: The operator performs a self-check every hour with a go/no-go gauge, and QA performs a patrol inspection every two hours with a caliper and a micrometer. Both results are recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 作業員每小時用通止規自檢，品保每兩小時用卡尺跟分厘卡巡檢。兩邊的結果都記在製程管制表上。

words.translation: 冷靜地（adj. calm 平靜的）
words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: Sometimes, she has to complain about problems in the office. But today, the situation is better, and she can work calmly.
general.zh: 有時候，她必須抱怨辦公室裡的問題。但今天，情況比較好，她可以平靜地工作。

general.en: I have also noticed that colleagues who once panicked during a warning now respond much more calmly.
general.zh: 我也注意到，那些以前一聽到警報就慌張的同事，現在反應冷靜多了。

general.en: Luckily, I managed to have a good rapport with the customer. I explained the situation calmly, and eventually, he agreed to pay the invoice.
general.zh: 幸好，我設法和客戶維持了良好的關係。我冷靜地說明情況，最後他同意付款。

general.en: I explained the situation calmly.
general.zh: 我冷靜地說明情況。

general.en: He handled the situation calmly.
general.zh: 他冷靜地處理了這個狀況。

general.en: The key to a happy shared home is communication. Roommates need to negotiate things like chores, grocery shopping, and noise levels. "We should negotiate our differences calmly instead of arguing," is good advice for any roommate situation.
general.zh: 和睦同住的關鍵是溝通。室友們需要就家事、採購和噪音大小等事項進行協商。「我們應該平靜地協商彼此的分歧，而不是爭吵，」這是適用於任何室友情況的好建議。

words.definition: to decide that something planned will not happen

general.en: The flights will be cancelled if the typhoon hits.
general.zh: 如果颱風登陸，班機將被取消。

general.en: I want to cancel my ticket and request a refund.
general.zh: 我想要取消我的票並要求退款。

general.en: Can I cancel this ticket and get my money back?
general.zh: 我可以取消這張票並把錢拿回來嗎？

general.en: I need to cancel my ticket. Is a refund possible?
general.zh: 我需要取消我的票，可以退款嗎？

general.en: The meeting may well be canceled if the boss is still sick.
general.zh: 如果老闆還在生病，會議很可能會取消。

general.en: One travel policy covers cancellation for any reason; the cheap one only pays if the airline cancels. Big difference when things go south.
general.zh: 一份旅平險任何原因取消都賠；便宜那份只有航空公司取消才賠。出事時差很大。

words.lesson: 20260630 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: And if I booked the return and my plans changed, is there a cancellation fee?
general.zh: 那如果我訂了來回票、後來計畫變了，會有取消手續費嗎？

general.en: There's a small cancellation fee, but only if you cancel less than one day before.
general.zh: 會有一筆小額的取消手續費，不過只有在出發前一天以內取消才要付。

general.en: You don't have to pay a cancellation fee if you cancel before 24 hours of departure.
general.zh: 取消預訂所產生的費用；提前很久取消有時可免除。（出發前 24 小時取消免收取消費）

general.en: There is a small cancellation fee.
general.zh: 有一筆小額的取消手續費。

words.definition: Money you must pay if you cancel a booking.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: There is a small cancellation fee.
general.zh: 有一筆小額的取消手續費。

words.lesson: 20260630 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: The train has been cancelled due to an accident.
general.zh: 因為一場意外，火車已經被取消了。

general.en: The airline announced that the flight was cancelled.
general.zh: stopped and not happening（停止且不再進行）

general.en: The flights will be cancelled if the typhoon hits.
general.zh: 如果颱風登陸，班機將被取消。

general.en: Smart! Did you hear the airline cancelled some flights too?
general.zh: 聰明！你有聽說航空公司也取消了一些航班嗎？

general.en: Yes, I checked the news this morning. Several flights were cancelled.
general.zh: 有，我今天早上看了新聞。好幾班航班被取消了。

general.en: This morning, Amy checked the news and learned that the airline cancelled several flights. She has already prepared candles, water, and snacks for the storm. Her neighbor came over, and together they taped all the windows.
general.zh: 今天早上，Amy看新聞，得知航空公司取消了好幾班航班。她已經準備好蠟燭、水和一些零食來應付這場暴風。鄰居過來幫忙，他們一起把所有窗戶都貼上了膠帶。

qa.en: What is the process capability for this dimension?
qa.zh: 這個尺寸的製程能力是多少？

qa.en: The key characteristic is monitored by control chart and the process capability index is reviewed monthly.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用管制圖盯，Cpk 每個月檢討。

qa.en: A capability below the target triggers an improvement plan before the trend can produce out-of-specification product.
qa.zh: Cpk 低於目標就啟動改善計畫，趁還沒做出超規品之前先處理。

qa.en: Pull the historical capability data for the same feature on a similar part instead of arguing from memory.
qa.zh: 把類似零件同一個特徵的歷史能力資料調出來，不要憑印象吵。

qa.en: Our process capability for this feature is about ±0.15 mm.
qa.zh: 這個特徵我們的製程能力大約是 ±0.15 mm。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

qa.en: The capability study on the special characteristics is still missing.
qa.zh: 特殊特性的能力研究還缺著。

qa.en: This PPAP is not complete. Please send the control plan, the MSA and the capability study.
qa.zh: 這份 PPAP 資料不齊，請補管制計畫、MSA 跟能力研究。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

qa.en: The following are missing: control plan, measurement system analysis, capability study for the designated special characteristics, and the material certificate.
qa.zh: 缺的項目有：管制計畫、MSA、特殊特性的能力研究、還有材證。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: We need to buy some coffee capsules.
general.zh: 我們需要買一些咖啡膠囊。

words.definition: The person in charge of a plane or ship.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: The captain had to wait in the air for 30 minutes.
general.zh: 機長必須在空中等待 30 分鐘。

general.en: Captain is the role; pilot is the profession.
general.zh: captain 是職務、pilot 是職業。

general.en: The captain welcomed us on board.
general.zh: 機長歡迎我們登機。

words.definition: A device in a car that makes a loud warning sound.

general.en: The car horn is stuck and won't stop honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住了，一直響不停。

general.en: The car horn got stuck, so it kept honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住，所以一直按個不停。

words.translation: 紙板、瓦楞紙(cardboard box 紙箱)

general.en: The accessory box is made of thin cardboard.
general.zh: 配件盒是用薄紙板做的。

general.en: The operator puts the accessories into a small cardboard box and seals the box with tape.
general.zh: 作業員先把配件放進小紙箱，並用膠帶封箱。

general.en: The operator uses a staple gun to secure the cardboard box.
general.zh: 作業員使用釘槍固定紙箱。

general.en: We use cardboard boxes for packaging.
general.zh: 我們用紙箱包裝。

words.definition: The lower part of a plane where luggage is stored.

general.en: Checked bags are stored in the aircraft's cargo hold.
general.zh: 託運行李存放在飛機的貨艙裡。

words.definition: kind and helpful to other people.

general.en: Sarah is a good friend because she's kind and caring.
general.zh: Sarah 是個好朋友，因為她善良又有愛心。

words.definition: A person who builds or repairs things made of wood, such as doors or furniture.

general.en: The carpenter repaired a broken door and installed new shelves.
general.zh: 木匠修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。

general.en: The carpenter installed new shelves.
general.zh: 木工安裝了新層架。

general.en: I also had some minor repairs done by a carpenter, who repaired a broken door and installed new shelves. An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire, ensuring that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 我也請木匠做了一些小型修繕，他修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。一位電工來修理故障的電線，確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

general.en: It was a long day, but I realized how important it is to have skilled professionals like plumbers, electricians, carpenters, and civil servants. They help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 這是漫長的一天，但我意識到擁有像水管工人、電工、木匠和公務員等熟練的專業人員有多麼重要。他們幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

words.definition: A small bag you take onto the plane with you.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: You can bring one carry-on onto the plane.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李上飛機。

general.en: Your carry-on bags will pass through an X-ray machine.
general.zh: 你的隨身行李會通過 X 光機掃描。

general.en: You can take a carry-on bag into the cabin.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李進客艙。

general.en: The carry-on baggage weight limit is 7 kg on budget airlines.
general.zh: 廉價航空的隨身行李重量限制是7公斤。

general.en: When I boarded the plane, I put my carry-on bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 當我登機時，我把隨身行李放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: You can bring one carry-on bag.
general.zh: 你可以帶一個隨身行李。

words.definition: A small bag you take onto the plane with you.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Your carry-on bags will pass through an X-ray machine.
general.zh: 你的隨身行李會通過 X 光機掃描。

general.en: You can take a carry-on bag into the cabin.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李進客艙。

general.en: When I boarded the plane, I put my carry-on bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 當我登機時，我把隨身行李放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: It's usually eight hundred dollars, but you could move something into your carry-on bag instead.
general.zh: 通常是八百元，不過您也可以把一些東西移到隨身行李裡。

general.en: Good idea. I'll take my books out and put them in my carry-on bag.
general.zh: 好主意。我把書拿出來放進隨身行李。

general.en: You can bring one carry-on bag.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over design from the previous model.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用上一代機種的設計。

words.definition: To talk with someone about what has happened since you last met.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: I missed two classes and now I need to catch up on the reading.
general.zh: 我缺了兩堂課，現在得補上那些閱讀進度。

general.en: It has been a long wait, but it seems the routes are finally starting to catch up with how much people actually travel.
general.zh: 這是一段很長的等待，但看起來航線終於開始跟上人們實際的旅行需求了。

general.en: They are working overtime to catch up with the delayed schedule.
general.zh: 他們正在加班，為了趕上延誤的進度。

general.en: I need to study harder to catch up.
general.zh: 我需要更努力學習才能趕上進度。

general.en: I need to catch up with my classmates.
general.zh: 我需要趕上同學們的進度。

general.en: Let's catch up tomorrow!
general.zh: 我們明天敘敘舊吧！

words.definition: to make something happen, especially something bad.

general.en: Lack of sleep caused her to make mistakes.
general.zh: 睡眠不足導致她犯錯。

general.en: The pipe burst due to high pressure, causing water damage.
general.zh: 水管因高壓而爆裂，造成水損。

general.en: The doctor was able to identify the cause of the pain.
general.zh: 醫生能夠找出疼痛的原因。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: Drinking contaminated water can cause severe diarrhea.
general.zh: 喝到受污染的水會導致嚴重的腹瀉。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: What is the root cause, and when can you send us the 8D report?
qa.zh: 根本原因是什麼？8D 報告什麼時候可以給我們？

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.definition: A large hole in the side of a hill or under the ground.
words.lesson: 20260728 越南寧平旅遊、take someone place、時間句型

general.en: The boat operator took me through several caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過好幾個洞穴。

general.en: The cave was the best place to avoid the heat in the summer.
general.zh: 洞穴是夏天躲避暑熱最好的地方。

general.en: The boat operator took me through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過那些洞穴。

general.en: The boat operator took us through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我們穿過洞穴。

words.definition: The surface that forms the top of the inside of a room.

general.en: One of the ceiling tiles came off in my apartment.
general.zh: 我公寓裡的一片天花板磁磚掉落了。

general.en: There is a leak in the bathroom ceiling.
general.zh: 浴室天花板在漏水。

general.en: What would you do if a ceiling tile fell off at your home?
general.zh: 如果你家的天花板磁磚掉下來，你會怎麼做？

general.en: The city council placed a ceiling on how much landlords can raise rent each year.
general.zh: 市議會對房東每年可調漲的租金設了上限。

general.en: There's water coming through the ceiling in the bathroom, and the wall feels wet.
general.zh: 浴室的天花板一直在漏水，牆壁摸起來也是濕的。

general.en: By the evening, everything was fixed. The tiles were replaced, the sink was reattached, and the ceiling was safe again. I felt relieved and thanked all the professionals for their hard work.
general.zh: 到了傍晚，所有東西都修好了。磁磚被換新了，水槽被重新固定，天花板也再次變得安全。我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員的辛勤工作。

words.translation: 天花板磁磚（輕鋼架天花板）
words.definition: one of the flat panels that make up the surface of a ceiling

general.en: What would you do if a ceiling tile fell off at your home?
general.zh: 如果你家的天花板磁磚掉下來，你會怎麼做？

general.en: One of the ceiling tiles came off in my apartment.
general.zh: 我公寓裡的一片天花板磁磚掉落了。

words.definition: to do something enjoyable or special to mark an important event or occasion.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: Taichung Park was decorated with lanterns to celebrate the Lantern Festival.
general.zh: 台中公園為了慶祝元宵節而掛滿燈籠。

general.en: Celebrating birthdays as a group can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 一群人慶祝生日可以建立持久的友誼。

general.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated mainly in the United States and Canada.
general.zh: 感恩節是一個主要在美國和加拿大慶祝的國家節日。

general.en: People celebrate with traditions that bring hope and happiness.
general.zh: 假期間拜廟與探親，象徵希望與幸福。

general.en: We invited six neighbors to a small dinner party to celebrate moving into our new house.
general.zh: 我們邀請了六位鄰居來參加小型晚餐派對，慶祝搬進新家。

general.en: For many employees, the year-end banquet is one of the most important company events of the year because it's fun, social, and a way to celebrate together.
general.zh: 對許多員工來說，尾牙是一年中最重要的公司活動之一，因為氣氛輕鬆、有趣，大家可以一起慶祝。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: The cello has a deep, warm sound.
general.zh: 大提琴的聲音低沉溫暖。

general.en: The cemetery is quiet in the morning.
general.zh: 公墓早晨很安靜。

words.definition: Yes, of course.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Certainly. Would you like anything else?
general.zh: 當然。您還需要別的嗎？

general.en: Certainly. I'll bring one once the seat belt sign is off.
general.zh: 沒問題。安全帶指示燈熄滅後我就拿一條給您。

qa.en: Certainly. Let me walk you through the durability test area first, and then the environmental chambers.
qa.zh: 當然。先帶您看耐久測試區，接著是環境試驗箱。

general.en: The shop owner showed us a certificate proving the leather bag was genuine.
general.zh: 店主給我們看一張證書，證明那個皮包是真皮的。

general.en: Swimming instructors at the community pool need a lifeguard certification before they start.
general.zh: 社區泳池的游泳教練開始上課前需要取得救生員認證。

general.en: Companies want problem solvers, not people who only collect certificates.
general.zh: 企業要的是能解決問題的人，而不是只會收集證書的人。

general.en: Exactly. And Taiwan is moving the same way. Companies now want work samples and real tasks, not just certificates.
general.zh: 沒錯。而且台灣也在往同一個方向走。企業現在要的是工作實例和實作任務，不只是證書。

qa.en: We have ISO 9001. I can show you the certificate.
qa.zh: 我們有 ISO 9001，我可以給您看證書。

qa.en: Routine testing is performed in-house; certification testing is performed by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內做，認證測試送有認證的實驗室。

qa.en: Tensile testing is performed on every incoming material lot, and the mill certificate is cross-checked against our own test result.
qa.zh: 每批進料都做拉伸，材證跟我們自己測的結果會互相對。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: The broker cannot file the entry without the certificate of compliance data.
qa.zh: 沒有 CoC 的資料，報關行報不了關。

general.en: Swimming instructors at the community pool need a lifeguard certification before they start.
general.zh: 社區泳池的游泳教練開始上課前需要取得救生員認證。

qa.en: Routine testing is performed in-house; certification testing is performed by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內做，認證測試送有認證的實驗室。

qa.en: Please provide the material certification for the new grade.
qa.zh: 請提供新等級的材證。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

qa.en: Decide what re-qualification is needed — at minimum material certification, and possibly UV and impact testing for outdoor-exposed parts.
qa.zh: 決定要重新驗證哪些——至少要材證，外露件可能還要做 UV 跟衝擊測試。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: Ask your certification body for a transition schedule after 16 September — they will have one they did not have last month.
qa.zh: 9 月 16 日以後再問一次驗證機構的轉版時程 —— 上個月他們還沒有，現在會有了。

qa.en: Do not promise a certification date to a customer before your certification body has given you one.
qa.zh: 驗證機構還沒給你日期之前，不要先跟客戶承諾什麼時候拿到證書。

qa.en: The new standard comes out in September. We are waiting for our certification body to give us a date.
qa.zh: 新標準九月才出來，我們在等驗證機構給我們日期。

qa.en: Ask your certification body now for their transition schedule and audit availability — slots fill up from the publication date onwards.
qa.zh: 現在就去問驗證機構轉版時程和稽核檔期 —— 發布日一到，檔期就會開始被搶。

qa.en: Ask your certification body in writing which audit they plan to fold each transition into — they will have their own cut-off, earlier than these dates.
qa.zh: 用書面問驗證機構：兩張證書的轉版各打算排在哪一次稽核。他們自己會有截止日，比上面這些日期早。

qa.en: The deadlines are September 2029 for ISO 9001 and April 2029 for ISO 14001. Our certificates are valid until then. We are asking our certification body which audit they will do it in.
qa.zh: 期限是 ISO 9001 到 2029 年 9 月、ISO 14001 到 2029 年 4 月。在那之前我們的證書都有效。我們正在問驗證機構要排在哪一次稽核做。

general.en: There were not enough chairs for everyone at the meeting.
general.zh: 會議上椅子不夠每個人坐。

general.en: I'm afraid there aren't any chairs. I hope you don't mind standing up.
general.zh: 3. 恐怕沒有椅子了，希望你不介意站著。（⭐ 課堂答案）

general.en: This chair is very comfortable. / I feel comfortable in my new job.
general.zh: 這張椅子坐起來非常舒服。／我在新工作裡感到很自在。

general.en: I sat in the dental chair while the dentist examined my teeth.
general.zh: 牙醫檢查我的牙齒時，我坐在牙醫診療椅上。

general.en: The dentist lowered the dental chair before starting the procedure.
general.zh: 牙醫在開始療程前把診療椅放低。

general.en: Please have a seat on the chair.
general.zh: 請坐在椅子上。

general.en: The course is, admittedly, quite challenging for beginners.
general.zh: 這門課對初學者來說，確實蠻有挑戰性的。

general.en: It's been challenging. I've been given a lot of homework every week.
general.zh: 滿有挑戰性的。我每週都被交代很多作業。

general.en: Living with roommates can be both convenient and challenging.
general.zh: 和室友住在一起可能既方便又具挑戰性。（句型 S + can be both A and B；both A and B 連接兩個平行的形容詞。）

general.en: I found it challenging to communicate with foreign clients.
general.zh: 我發現與外國客戶溝通具有挑戰性。

general.en: I found it quite challenging, but I learned a lot.
general.zh: 我覺得頗具挑戰性，但我學到了很多。

general.en: Shared living can be challenging.
general.zh: 合租生活可能具挑戰性。

qa.en: Measure the chamfer angle with the digital bevel protractor.
qa.zh: 用電子角度規量測倒角角度。

qa.en: Add a 0.5 mm chamfer to the hole edge.
qa.zh: 孔緣請加 0.5 mm 倒角。

qa.en: Raise the missing change notice — the process change control gap matters more than this one report.
qa.zh: 漏開的變更通知要補開——製程變更管不住，比這一份報告嚴重多了。

qa.en: The fixture was changed without a change notice.
qa.zh: 夾具更換沒有開變更通知。

qa.en: Any change to a specification requires an engineering change notice and, where it affects form, fit, or function, your written approval before implementation.
qa.zh: 規格要改要先發 ECN；如果影響到形狀、配合或功能，要你們書面核准才能實施。

qa.en: Separately, the fixture change was made without a change notice. Please confirm who will raise it retrospectively so the change control record is complete.
qa.zh: 另外，這次換夾具沒有開變更通知。請確認誰來補開，變更管制的紀錄才會完整。

qa.en: Only the current revision on the shop floor is valid. Superseded drawings are removed immediately, and any change requires an engineering change notice before production may use it.
qa.zh: 現場只有現行版有效。舊版圖面馬上收掉，要改一定要先發 ECN 才能用在生產。

words.definition: likely to change frequently; = unpredictable (for weather)

general.en: The weather is often changeable in the mountains.
general.zh: 山區天氣常常多變。

general.en: Let's not cancel yet. The weather here is so changeable — it can be pouring at ten and sunny at noon.
general.zh: 先別急著取消。這裡的天氣很多變，可能十點還在下大雨，中午就出太陽了。

general.en: That's true. Taiwan's summer weather is really changeable.
general.zh: 也對。台灣夏天的天氣真的很多變。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: Will there be any extra charges or penalties?
general.zh: 會有額外的費用或罰款嗎？

general.en: The lawyer charges 3,000 dollars for a one-hour consultation.
general.zh: 那位律師一小時的諮詢費是三千元。

general.en: The lawyer charges a fixed fee of five thousand dollars per case.
general.zh: 那位律師每個案子收取五千元的固定費用。

general.en: The hotel let us rebook our stay for the following weekend at no extra charge.
general.zh: 飯店讓我們免費改訂到下個週末入住。

general.en: The bank charges very little interest on student loans.
general.zh: 這家銀行對學生貸款只收很少的利息。

general.en: I need to charge my laptop.
general.zh: 我需要幫筆電充電。

qa.en: The company agreed to pay a civil penalty to settle the charges.
qa.zh: 那家公司同意付民事罰款來和解。

qa.en: The settlement has been provisionally accepted by the Commission and is subject to public comment, so it is not final. The figures quoted (874 reports, 71 injuries, the date range) are CPSC's own charges as stated in the release.
qa.zh: 這個和解是委員會先暫時接受、還要等公眾意見，還沒定案。文中的數字（874 件通報、71 件受傷、那段期間）是 CPSC 新聞稿裡的指控內容。

qa.en: The Pareto chart shows that paint defects account for 60 % of all rejects.
qa.zh: 柏拉圖顯示烤漆不良佔了所有拒收的 60%。

qa.en: We plot the frame welding gap on a control chart every two hours.
qa.zh: 我們每兩小時把車架焊接間隙點在管制圖上。

qa.en: Monitoring a process with control charts and expressing how well it fits inside the specification limits.
qa.zh: 用管制圖盯製程，再用一個指數（Cpk）講製程落在規格內的程度。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: We chart the key characteristic with X-bar and R charts. Cpk above 1.33 is the target; below 1.33 requires a process improvement plan even when all parts are still within specification.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用 X-bar／R 管制圖盯。Cpk 目標 1.33 以上；低於 1.33，就算每件都在規格內，還是要提改善計畫。

qa.en: The current Cpk for this dimension is 1.52 based on the last thirty subgroups, which is above our internal target of 1.33. The control chart shows no out-of-control points.
qa.zh: 看最近 30 組子群，這個尺寸 Cpk 是 1.52，高於我們內部目標 1.33，管制圖也沒有失控點。

words.lesson: 20260324 While 用法與英文學習練習

general.en: Managers see it differently — the little hallway chats that build trust just disappear, and new hires have no one to ask.
general.zh: 主管的看法就不同了——建立信任的走廊閒聊全沒了，新人也找不到人問。

general.en: A chat conversation is casual and friendly.
general.zh: 聊天式的對話是輕鬆且友善的。

general.en: Let's have a short chat to practice speaking.
general.zh: 我們來簡短地聊聊天，練習一下口說吧。

general.en: We had a chat about our learning goals.
general.zh: 我們閒聊了學習目標。（a friendly informal conversation）

qa.en: There are chatter marks on the machined surface.

words.definition: the American English word for the piece of paper showing how much you must pay at a restaurant.

general.en: Checked bags are stored in the aircraft's cargo hold.
general.zh: 託運行李存放在飛機的貨艙裡。

general.en: Check-in opens two hours before the flight.
general.zh: 報到手續在班機起飛前兩小時開始。

general.en: She planned to eat bland dishes before her health check.
general.zh: 她計劃在健康檢查前吃清淡的料理。

general.en: Please check the departure time on your ticket.
general.zh: 請確認你票上的出發時間。

general.en: Could we have the check, please?
general.zh: 可以給我們帳單嗎？（美式說法）

general.en: We went through the security check.
general.zh: 我們通過了安檢。

qa.en: QA builds quality into the treadmill production process; QC checks the finished treadmills.
qa.zh: 品保把品質做進跑步機的製程裡；品管則檢查完成的跑步機。

qa.en: Check the motor noise of every treadmill before packing.
qa.zh: 包裝前檢查每台跑步機的馬達噪音。

qa.en: Judging a whole lot by inspecting only a sample drawn from it, instead of checking every piece.
qa.zh: 只抽一部分來檢，用抽出來的結果判整批，不是每件都檢。

qa.en: We check some pieces from each lot, not all of them.
qa.zh: 我們每批抽幾件檢查，不是全部都檢。

qa.en: We look up a letter in the table, and the letter tells us how many to check.
qa.zh: 我們在表上查一個代字，代字告訴我們要檢查幾件。

qa.en: A higher level means we check more pieces.
qa.zh: 水準越高，我們檢查的件數越多。

words.definition: Registering at the airport before a flight.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Check-in opens two hours before the flight.
general.zh: 報到手續在班機起飛前兩小時開始。

general.en: Good morning. May I see your passport? This is the check-in counter for Flight 725 to Tokyo.
general.zh: 早安，可以看一下您的護照嗎？這裡是飛往東京 725 班機的報到櫃檯。

general.en: The traveler left his passport on the check-in desk.
general.zh: 那位旅客把護照留在報到櫃檯。

words.definition: Bags you hand to the airline to store on the plane.

general.en: We checked in two bags for our trip to Japan.
general.zh: 我們為了日本之旅託運了兩件行李。

general.en: This isn't their first weather mess this year — that new backup checklist has already saved them twice this month.
general.zh: 這不是他們今年第一次被天氣搞——新的備援清單這個月已經救了他們兩次。

general.en: Before our camping trip, Dad made a checklist so we would not forget the tent or flashlights.
general.zh: 露營之前，爸爸做了一張檢查清單，這樣我們就不會忘了帶帳篷或手電筒。

general.en: Our backup checklist, which barely existed a year ago, has already been used several times this season.
general.zh: 我們的備援檢查清單，一年前根本還沒成形，這一季已經被用過好幾次了。

qa.en: We have added this item to the inspection checklist to prevent recurrence.
qa.zh: 「會注意」不是對策，客戶聽了只會更擔心。要講你改了哪份文件、加了哪個管制點、怎麼確認有效。

qa.en: Send the supplier the element checklist for the level you requested, with the missing items ticked — not a general complaint.
qa.zh: 把你要求那個等級的 PPAP 清單寄給供應商，缺的項目直接勾出來——不要只寫一句「資料不齊」。

qa.en: Here is the element checklist with the missing items marked.
qa.zh: 這是 PPAP 清單，缺的項目我已經標出來了。

qa.en: At the end, we fill in the checklist. We write down the date, the part number, how many we checked, and the result. If the sample passes, the whole lot can go to the line. If it fails, we hold the lot and call the supplier.
qa.zh: 最後，我們填寫檢查表。寫下日期、料號、檢查數量和結果。如果樣本合格，整批就可以送上產線。如果不合格，我們扣住整批並通知供應商。

qa.en: At the end, we fill in the checklist.

words.definition: to make someone feel happier.

general.en: She knows just how to cheer me up.
general.zh: 她很知道怎麼讓我開心起來。

words.definition: to become happier, or to make someone happier.

general.en: Cheer up! This is not the end of the world.
general.zh: 振作起來！這不是世界末日。

general.en: When he was asked why he was so pessimistic about life, Laurie said it was because he is Scottish. Because of his reputation as a pessimist, complete strangers come up to him on the street and say, "Cheer up, it'll never happen!"
general.zh: 當他被問到為何對人生如此悲觀時，羅利說那是因為他是蘇格蘭人。因為他悲觀者的名聲，常有陌生人在街上走向他說：「振作點，壞事不會發生的！」

words.definition: a professional cook, especially the main cook in a restaurant or kitchen
words.lesson: 20260708 A Flight Problem 航班旅遊閱讀

general.en: A chef may be employed to prepare meals for residents.
general.zh: 可能會聘請廚師為住客準備餐點。

general.en: Some long-stay apartments arrange a chef to prepare meals for guests.
general.zh: 在「長租公寓有時會安排廚師為住客準備餐點」的情境下提到。

general.en: Most of a chef's day is spent on unglamorous tasks like chopping onions.
general.zh: 廚師一天大部分時間都在做切洋蔥這類平淡的工作。

general.en: The chef asked customers for honest feedback on the new dessert menu.
general.zh: 主廚請客人對新的甜點菜單提供誠實的回饋意見。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: Our team has great chemistry.
general.zh: 我們團隊很有默契。

general.en: We have great chemistry.
general.zh: 我們很有默契。

general.en: We have good chemistry.
general.zh: 答案：chemistry（私人關係的默契）

general.en: I took out some chicken nuggets.
general.zh: small fried chicken pieces（小塊的炸雞）

words.definition: to relax and do nothing special.

general.en: Sometimes they just chill in the park beside the church.
general.zh: 有時她們就在教堂旁的公園裡放鬆。

general.en: Just chill out and enjoy the weekend.
general.zh: 放鬆一下，享受週末吧。

words.definition: small regular tasks done around the house, like cleaning and washing dishes

general.en: Roommates need to negotiate chores so everyone shares the work fairly.
general.zh: 室友們需要協商家事，以便每個人都能公平地分擔工作。

general.en: Before dinner, I feed the animals and do a few chores.
general.zh: 晚餐前我餵動物、做一些家事。

general.en: I have to do my household chores before I can go out with friends.
general.zh: 在我和朋友出門之前，我必須先做完家事。（have to + 原形表客觀「必須」。另例：Sharing household chores with roommates can prevent arguments. 與室友分擔家事可以預防爭吵——動名詞當主詞；prevent + 名詞。）

general.en: Household chores are another common issue. Who takes out the trash, washes the dishes, or cleans the bathroom?
general.zh: 家務是另一個常見的問題。誰去倒垃圾、洗碗或打掃浴室？（another + 單數名詞；Who 當主詞視為單數，後接 takes、washes、cleans。）

general.en: When chores are ignored, tension can build quickly, so it's important to set rules early and stick to them.
general.zh: 當家務被忽視時，緊張氣氛會迅速累積，所以儘早制定規則並遵守它們是很重要的。（are ignored 為被動語態；it 為虛主詞；stick to + 名詞 堅持／遵守。）

general.en: The key to a happy shared home is communication. Roommates need to negotiate things like chores, grocery shopping, and noise levels. "We should negotiate our differences calmly instead of arguing," is good advice for any roommate situation.
general.zh: 和睦同住的關鍵是溝通。室友們需要就家事、採購和噪音大小等事項進行協商。「我們應該平靜地協商彼此的分歧，而不是爭吵，」這是適用於任何室友情況的好建議。

qa.en: The citation code has to come from the brand — it depends on which CPSC rule the model is certified against.
qa.zh: Citation Code 要跟品牌商拿，那要看這個型號是照 CPSC 哪一條發證的。

qa.en: I can give you five of the seven now. The lab address and the citation code I need until tomorrow morning.
qa.zh: 七項裡面五項我現在就可以給。實驗室地址和 Citation Code 要到明天早上。

qa.en: Action: reply to the broker and copy the brand's compliance contact, asking the brand to confirm the citation code. That question belongs to them.
qa.zh: 行動：回信給報關行，副本給品牌商的法規窗口，請品牌商確認 Citation Code。那個問題本來就是他們的。

qa.en: Ask the brand which citation code applies to each model — it is their call, and it is the one field we cannot answer from our own records.
qa.zh: 跟品牌商問每個型號對應哪一條 Citation Code —— 那是他們決定的，也是七項裡唯一我們自己的紀錄回答不了的。

qa.en: Yes. We can give you manufacture date and place, test date and the lab from our records. Please tell us which citation code applies to each model.
qa.zh: 可以。製造日期跟地點、測試日期跟實驗室，我們的紀錄裡都有。Citation Code 是哪一條，請您告訴我們每個型號要填什麼。

qa.en: Risk: Citation Codes is a determination about which CPSC rule the model is certified against. If you guess it and it is wrong, the filing is wrong in the importer's name, not yours.
qa.zh: 風險：Citation Codes 是「這個型號照 CPSC 哪一條規則發證」的判斷。你猜錯了，錯的申報是掛在進口商名下，不是掛在你名下。

qa.en: The company agreed to pay a civil penalty to settle the charges.
qa.zh: 那家公司同意付民事罰款來和解。

words.definition: A person who works for the government and helps run public services.

general.en: I met a civil servant at the local government office to ask about my documents.
general.zh: 我在當地政府辦公室見了一位公務員，詢問關於我文件的事。

general.en: It was a long day, but I realized how important it is to have skilled professionals like plumbers, electricians, carpenters, and civil servants. They help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 這是漫長的一天，但我意識到擁有像水管工人、電工、木匠和公務員等熟練的專業人員有多麼重要。他們幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: And watch the deductible — some are so high that small claims aren't even worth filing.
general.zh: 還要注意自負額——有些高到小額理賠根本不值得申請。

general.en: After the storm damaged their roof, the couple filed a claim with their home insurer.
general.zh: 暴風雨毀損屋頂後，這對夫妻向住宅保險公司提出了理賠申請。

general.en: Can I have an itemised receipt so I can claim the expense from my company?
general.zh: 可以給我一張逐項列明的收據嗎？我要跟公司報帳。

general.en: They claim to have solved the problem.
general.zh: 他們聲稱已經解決了問題。

qa.en: I would rather have a high action priority now than a warranty claim later.
qa.zh: 我寧可現在行動優先度高一點，也不要以後多一件保固客訴。

qa.en: Keep AI-related claims out of your technical file unless engineering can substantiate them.
qa.zh: 工程那邊證明不了的 AI 宣稱，不要寫進技術文件。

qa.en: ISO has confirmed the approval and the publication date. The detailed content of the sixth edition is not public until publication, so avoid making specific claims about what changed.
qa.zh: ISO 確認的是通過和發布日期，第六版的詳細內容發布前不公開 —— 「改了什麼」不要講得太具體。

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: He plays the clarinet in the orchestra.
general.zh: 他在管弦樂團吹單簧管。

words.definition: 時間重疊或意見不合

general.en: The two meetings clash, so we need to reschedule.
general.zh: 兩個會議時間衝突，需要重新安排。

general.en: Their schedules clash, so they can't meet for lunch.
general.zh: 他們的時間表有衝突，所以無法一起吃午餐。（clash 作不及物動詞；so 連接因果。另例：The colors of your shirt and pants clash. 你襯衫和褲子的顏色不搭——主詞複數動詞保持原形。Living together can cause routines to clash, like one person wanting quiet while another plays music. 住在一起可能會導致作息衝突——cause + 受詞 + to V。）

general.en: His opinion clashed with hers during the discussion.
general.zh: 在討論中，他的意見與她的發生了衝突。（搭配 with）

general.en: On the other hand, daily routines can clash: one person may prefer quiet mornings, while another likes to play music while cooking breakfast.
general.zh: 另一方面，日常作息可能會起衝突：一個人可能偏好安靜的早晨，而另一個人則喜歡在做早餐時放音樂。（第一個 while 表對比「然而」；第二個 while 是「當…的時候」，接分詞構句 cooking。）

general.en: Daily routines can clash.
general.zh: 日常作息可能會起衝突。

general.en: Tom had a very busy Monday. Two of his meetings clashed at the same time. He had to reschedule one of them. "I'll move the afternoon meeting to Wednesday," he told his assistant.
general.zh: Tom 週一非常忙碌。他有兩個會議時間衝突。他不得不把其中一個重新安排。「我把下午的會議改到週三，」他告訴助理。

general.en: Communication between clients and internal teams.
general.zh: 客戶與內部團隊之間的溝通。

general.en: I communicate regularly with clients to ensure alignment.
general.zh: 我也會定期與客戶溝通，以確保雙方的需求與方向保持一致。

general.en: Keeping your promises is the easiest way to build trust with clients.
general.zh: 遵守承諾是跟客戶建立信任最簡單的方式。

general.en: The photographer brought a portfolio of wedding and travel photos to show potential clients.
general.zh: 那位攝影師帶了一本婚禮和旅遊照片的作品集，給潛在客戶看。

general.en: She has a good rapport with her clients.
general.zh: 她和客戶關係很好。

general.en: Q: What are your main responsibilities? I inspect and test fitness equipment. I find problems and report them to the design engineers. I also communicate with clients.
general.zh: Q: 你的主要職責是什麼？ 我負責檢驗和測試健身器材。我會找出問題並回報給設計工程師。同時，我也會與客戶溝通。

qa.en: The draft is at close of voting, so it has not published and we do not quote its content.
qa.zh: 草案在投票結束階段，還沒發布，裡面的內容我們不對外講。

words.definition: A machine that measures a part in three axes with a touch probe and compares the result against the CAD model or drawing.
a fixed amount of money that you pay for medical care, with the rest covered by insurance.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: I had to pay a co-pay when I visited the dentist yesterday.
general.zh: 我昨天去看牙醫時，必須支付部分負擔費用 / 掛號費。

general.en: In Taiwan, most people have National Health Insurance (NHI). Joining it is compulsory for all citizens. Everyone pays a small monthly fee. When they see a doctor, they only pay a small co-pay.
general.zh: 在台灣，大多數人都有全民健康保險（全民健保）。加入全民健保對所有公民來說都是強制的。每個人每個月繳納少量費用。看醫生時，只需要支付小額的部分負擔。

qa.en: How many hours of salt spray does this coating pass?
qa.zh: 這個塗裝可以通過幾小時鹽霧？

qa.en: The thickness of the cured coating film, measured on the finished part in microns.
qa.zh: 成品上塗膜烤乾後的厚度，用微米量。

qa.en: What is the coating thickness, and where do you measure it?
qa.zh: 膜厚是多少？你們在哪裡量？

qa.en: A test that cuts a grid into the coating, applies tape, and removes it to see how much coating peels off.
qa.zh: 在塗層上劃格子、貼膠帶再撕掉，看掉了多少的附著力測試。

qa.en: We use the cross-hatch adhesion test per ASTM D3359. The acceptance criterion is class 5B, meaning no coating is removed from any of the one hundred squares.
qa.zh: 我們照 ASTM D3359 做百格，允收標準 5B，就是 100 格都不能有塗層掉下來。

qa.en: This powder coating passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray with no red rust and with creepage from the scribe line under one millimeter, which meets the requirement in the specification.
qa.zh: 這個粉體塗裝過 48 小時中性鹽霧，沒有紅鏽，劃線處擴散小於 1 mm，符合規格。

qa.en: The coating coverage rate and the color must meet the standard.
qa.zh: 上膜率與皮膜色澤必須符合標準。

qa.en: QA personnel are responsible for inspecting every step on the coating line.
qa.zh: 塗裝線每個步驟都由品保人員負責檢核。

words.definition: The thickness of the cured coating film, measured on the finished part in microns.

qa.en: Use the coating thickness gauge to measure the film thickness.
qa.zh: 用膜厚計量測漆膜厚度。

qa.en: Measure the paint thickness with the coating thickness gauge.
qa.zh: 用膜厚計量測漆膜厚度。

words.definition: to gently persuade someone to do something
words.lesson: 20260423 The Farmer and the Wise Woman

general.en: She coaxed the cat down from the tree with a treat.
general.zh: 她用食物把貓哄下樹。

general.en: They tried to coax the child to eat more vegetables.
general.zh: To persuade in a gentle way.（哄誘某人／動物做某事）

general.en: We tried to coax my younger brother to join us for a bike ride.
general.zh: 我們試著說服我弟弟和我們一起去騎腳踏車。

general.en: She coaxed the child to eat his vegetables.
general.zh: 她哄著孩子把蔬菜吃完。

general.en: The Wise Woman said, "Coax your horse to come inside your house by talking to it in a pleasant and gentle way." The farmer thought this an odd suggestion, but he did as he was told.
general.zh: 智者說：「用愉快溫和的方式對你的馬說話，哄勸（Coax）牠進到你的房子裡。」農夫覺得這個建議很奇怪，但他還是照做了。

general.en: I make coffee with the coffee maker every morning.
general.zh: 我每天早上用咖啡機泡咖啡。

general.en: My coffee maker uses pods, so I can make coffee quickly before going to work.
general.zh: 我的咖啡機用膠囊，所以上班前可以快速泡咖啡。

general.en: A cold front brought temperatures down by 10 degrees overnight.
general.zh: 冷鋒使氣溫在一夜之間下降了 10 度。

general.en: The cold front is expected to deliver snow to the mountains by Sunday night.
general.zh: 這波冷鋒預計在星期日晚上以前為山區帶來降雪。

words.definition: to fall down suddenly; or the act of falling down

general.en: The building collapsed during the earthquake.
general.zh: 那棟建築在地震中倒塌了。

general.en: Some buildings collapsed during the strong earthquake.
general.zh: 地震劇烈時，部分建築物倒塌了。

general.en: The old building collapsed in the earthquake.
general.zh: 那棟老建築在地震中倒塌了。

general.en: Rescue workers assembled outside the collapsed building.
general.zh: 救援人員在倒塌的建築物外集合。

general.en: After working twelve-hour shifts for a month, she collapsed from exhaustion.
general.zh: 連續上了一個月十二小時的班後，她累到倒下了。

general.en: Firefighters worked to rescue trapped people from the collapsed buildings.
general.zh: 消防員努力從倒塌建築物中救出受困者。

words.definition: a person you work with.

general.en: My colleague and I are on the same page about this problem.
general.zh: 我和同事對這個問題有共識。

general.en: My colleague had abdominal surgery and lost 20 kg.
general.zh: 我的同事做了腹部手術，瘦了 20 公斤。

general.en: Please apologize to your colleague if you made a mistake.
general.zh: 如果你犯了錯，請向你的同事道歉。

general.en: My colleague was smart — she skipped the line, called the airline's overseas number, and got rebooked in four minutes.
general.zh: 我同事很聰明——她不排隊，直接打航空公司的海外專線，四分鐘就改好票。

general.en: My colleague gave me a ride home when it suddenly started pouring.
general.zh: 突然下起大雨時，我的同事開車載我回家。

general.en: A colleague from accounting offered to cover my shift while I attended my cousin's wedding.
general.zh: 會計部的一位同事主動說要在我參加表妹婚禮時幫我代班。

words.definition: words that are often used together.

general.en: We'll do some exercises practising these collocations tomorrow.
general.zh: 我們明天會做一些練習，來練習這些搭配詞。

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4 against the approved master panel — our limit is 2.0, so the parts have to be re-sprayed.
qa.zh: 跟承認色板比，色差 ΔE 2.4，我們的上限是 2.0，所以這批要重噴。

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4, which exceeds our limit of 2.0.
qa.zh: 色差 ΔE 2.4，超過我們 2.0 的上限。

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4 against the master panel, which exceeds our limit of 2.0. The parts need to be re-sprayed.
qa.zh: 「不一樣、再噴一次」沒有判定依據，對方可以跟你吵到底差多少。把量測條件、數值、規格上限、後面要驗什麼講清楚，判定才站得住。

qa.en: The color difference is over the limit; delta E must be under 1.0.
qa.zh: 色差超出上限，ΔE 必須小於 1.0。

qa.en: The color difference ΔE is 0.6, within the tolerance of 1.0.
qa.zh: 色差 ΔE 為 0.6，在 1.0 的容差內。

qa.en: The trial batch is rejected: the color difference against the approved master panel is ΔE 2.4, above our 2.0 limit. The parts will be re-sprayed.
qa.zh: 試噴這批判退：跟承認色板比色差 ΔE 2.4，超過我們 2.0 的上限，這批要重噴。

words.definition: 物理或心理上感到放鬆、自在

general.en: These shoes were cheap, but they are very comfortable.
general.zh: 這雙鞋很便宜，但是穿起來很舒服。

general.en: Money can support a comfortable life, but it cannot guarantee happiness.
general.zh: 金錢可以支持舒適的生活，但無法保證幸福。

general.en: On the one hand, household chores are tiring; on the other hand, they keep the home clean and comfortable.
general.zh: 一方面，做家務很累；另一方面，它們能保持家裡整潔舒適。

general.en: This chair is very comfortable. / I feel comfortable in my new job.
general.zh: 這張椅子坐起來非常舒服。／我在新工作裡感到很自在。

general.en: I feel very comfortable in my new job.
general.zh: 我在新工作裡感到非常自在。

words.definition: 使人在悲傷或疲憊時感覺好一點的

general.en: It is comforting to eat a warm meal after a long day.
general.zh: 漫長一天後吃一頓熱食真的很療癒。

general.en: It is comforting to eat a fried chicken chop after a long day.
general.zh: 下班後吃一塊炸雞排，真的非常療癒。

general.en: Her words were very comforting after the bad news.
general.zh: 聽到壞消息後，她的話語給了人很大的寬慰。

general.en: It is comforting to know that you are not alone.
general.zh: 知道自己並非孤身一人，真是令人感到欣慰。

general.en: After a long day of meetings, a hot bowl of soup is very comforting.
general.zh: 經過一整天的會議後，一碗熱湯非常療癒。

general.en: "A warm bowl of soup after cleaning the fridge — that's truly comforting," she smiled. She reminded herself: when food looks or smells wrong, always throw it out.
general.zh: 「清完冰箱後喝一碗熱湯——真的非常療癒，」她微笑著說。她提醒自己：當食物看起來或聞起來不對勁時，一定要把它丟掉。

general.en: Typhoons are common in Taiwan in summer.
general.zh: 夏天颱風在台灣很常見。

general.en: Cosmetic surgery is becoming more common these days.
general.zh: 現在整形手術越來越普遍。

general.en: A nose job is one of the most common cosmetic operations.
general.zh: 隆鼻是最常見的整形手術之一。

general.en: It is a common issue.
general.zh: 這是常見的問題。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

general.en: The most common operation is called a nose job. People who are unhappy with their nose change its shape. Some people want to remove wrinkles so they can look younger. Others have surgery to make parts of their body bigger or smaller.
general.zh: 最常見的手術叫做「隆鼻手術」。對自己鼻子不滿意的人會改變鼻子的形狀。有些人想要消除皺紋，讓自己看起來更年輕。還有人透過手術，讓身體的某些部位變大或變小。

general.en: This communication failure became a significant obstacle.
general.zh: 這次的溝通失敗成了一大阻礙。

general.en: His communication skills are very good. He is a sociable person.
general.zh: 他的溝通能力很好。他是個善於交際的人。

general.en: She communicates effectively with her team.
general.zh: 她和團隊溝通很有效。

general.en: I communicate regularly with clients to ensure alignment.
general.zh: 我也會定期與客戶溝通，以確保雙方的需求與方向保持一致。

general.en: Good communication fosters strong teamwork.
general.zh: 良好的溝通能促進強大的團隊合作。

general.en: I communicate directly with clients.
general.zh: 我直接與客戶溝通。

qa.en: The revision change was not communicated to the supplier.
qa.zh: 改版的事沒有通知到供應商。

qa.en: The root cause is not the supplier — our ECN process failed to communicate the revision change. I will close the gap by requiring written confirmation of receipt for every drawing release.
qa.zh: 根因不在供應商，是我們的 ECN 流程沒把改版通知出去。我會把這個洞補起來：每次圖面發行都要對方書面回覆確認。

qa.en: The inspection failures were caused by a revision communication gap, not by supplier workmanship. Disposition is agreed, the Rev C cut-in is set for the next build, and the ECN process now requires supplier confirmation of receipt.
qa.zh: 檢驗判退是版次沒通知到造成的，不是供應商做工的問題。怎麼判已經有共識，C 版下一批投產切入，ECN 流程也加上供應商要回覆確認這一條。

general.en: This communication failure became a significant obstacle.
general.zh: 這次的溝通失敗成了一大阻礙。

general.en: His communication skills are very good. He is a sociable person.
general.zh: 他的溝通能力很好。他是個善於交際的人。

general.en: Good communication fosters strong teamwork.
general.zh: 良好的溝通能促進強大的團隊合作。

general.en: Clear communication is important.
general.zh: 清楚的溝通很重要。

general.en: Because of her effective communication and constant effort, the team solved the problems efficiently. They finished the project in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 因為她有效的溝通和持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就完成了專案，並收到了老闆的正面回饋。

general.en: The key to a happy shared home is communication. Roommates need to negotiate things like chores, grocery shopping, and noise levels. "We should negotiate our differences calmly instead of arguing," is good advice for any roommate situation.
general.zh: 和睦同住的關鍵是溝通。室友們需要就家事、採購和噪音大小等事項進行協商。「我們應該平靜地協商彼此的分歧，而不是爭吵，」這是適用於任何室友情況的好建議。

qa.en: The inspection failures were caused by a revision communication gap, not by supplier workmanship. Disposition is agreed, the Rev C cut-in is set for the next build, and the ECN process now requires supplier confirmation of receipt.
qa.zh: 檢驗判退是版次沒通知到造成的，不是供應商做工的問題。怎麼判已經有共識，C 版下一批投產切入，ECN 流程也加上供應商要回覆確認這一條。

words.definition: A group of people who live in the same area or share something in common.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: It becomes a small community where daily life is practiced and learned.
general.zh: 它變成一個小型社區，人們在那裡實踐和學習日常生活。

general.en: More people participate in community service during Thanksgiving.
general.zh: 越來越多人會在感恩節參與社區服務。

general.en: Swimming instructors at the community pool need a lifeguard certification before they start.
general.zh: 社區泳池的游泳教練開始上課前需要取得救生員認證。

general.en: We live in a safe community.
general.zh: 我們住在一個安全的社區。

general.en: Free vaccines are available at most clinics and community health stations. A short visit now can prevent a much longer illness later.
general.zh: 大部分診所與社區健康站都還有免費疫苗。現在去一趟，可能就能避免之後一場更長的病。

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively. Though it can get crowded, many people still enjoy visiting because it makes them feel connected to their community.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。雖然可能會變得很擁擠，許多人仍然喜歡造訪，因為這讓他們感到與社區有所連結。

words.definition: work done to help people in your area.

general.en: More people participate in community service during Thanksgiving.
general.zh: 越來越多人會在感恩節參與社區服務。

words.definition: to travel between home and work.

general.en: I ride a scooter to commute to work every morning.
general.zh: 我每天早上騎機車通勤上班。

general.en: Listening to podcasts makes my forty-minute commute feel much shorter.
general.zh: 聽 Podcast 讓我四十分鐘的通勤感覺短了很多。

general.en: One study estimated that commuting costs absorbed eight percent of household income.
general.zh: 一項研究估計，通勤成本吃掉了家庭收入的百分之八。

general.en: How do you commute to work every day?
general.zh: 你每天如何通勤上班？

general.en: Here's the kicker — moving to the suburbs doesn't always save you money once you add up commuting, daycare, and all that time in traffic.
general.zh: 重點來了——搬去郊區不一定省錢，把通勤、托育和塞車時間加起來就知道。

general.en: I commute by scooter.
general.zh: 我騎摩托車上下班。

words.definition: to force someone to do something.

general.en: The rain compelled us to stay indoors.
general.zh: 雨迫使我們待在室內。

words.definition: To give something to make up for a loss or problem.

general.en: The hotel gave us a free meal to compensate for the noisy room.
general.zh: 飯店給我們免費餐點，以補償房間太吵的問題。

general.en: The airline company offered a free ticket to compensate for the flight delay.
general.zh: 航空公司提供免費機票來補償航班延誤。

general.en: He compensated his wife for forgetting her birthday by taking her on a special trip.
general.zh: 他因為忘記太太的生日，而帶她去特別旅行作為補償。

general.en: The sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

general.en: The insurance company offered us compensation for the car accident.
general.zh: 保險公司為車禍事故提供我們賠償。

general.en: The concert was canceled because of the typhoon, so the sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 演唱會因颱風取消，贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

words.definition: Money or something else given to make up for a loss or problem.

general.en: The insurance company offered us compensation for the car accident.
general.zh: 保險公司為車禍事故提供我們賠償。

words.definition: An event in which people try to win against each other.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: There is a lot of competition in the market.
general.zh: 市場競爭很激烈。

general.en: Our school art competition has a prize for the most colorful painting.
general.zh: 我們學校的美術比賽有一個獎項頒給色彩最豐富的畫。

general.en: Now Tom practices every weekend at the same pool. He can swim about ten meters without stopping. There is a swimming competition for beginners in October.
general.zh: 現在Tom每個週末都在同一個泳池練習。他現在可以連續游大約十公尺不停。十月有一場給初學者的游泳比賽。

words.definition: to say that you are unhappy or not satisfied with something
words.lesson: 20260317 現在簡單式 現在進行式

general.en: My neighbor often complains about the noise.
general.zh: 我的鄰居常常抱怨噪音。

general.en: Sometimes, she has to complain about problems in the office. But today, the situation is better, and she can work calmly.
general.zh: 有時候，她必須抱怨辦公室裡的問題。但今天，情況比較好，她可以平靜地工作。

general.en: He hardly ever complains about the noise.
general.zh: 他幾乎不抱怨噪音。

general.en: Customers complained about damaged products.
general.zh: 顧客投訴損壞的產品。

general.en: The traffic is terrible in the morning and evening. At first, I didn't like it. My neighbor often complained about the noise. We even had an argument about parking one day.
general.zh: 早晚的交通非常糟糕。起初，我不喜歡這裡。我的鄰居經常抱怨噪音。有一天我們甚至因為停車問題發生了爭執。

general.en: The company began receiving several complaints from customers regarding damaged products.
general.zh: 公司開始收到好幾位顧客針對損壞產品的投訴。

general.en: We received a complaint about the wrong parts.
general.zh: 我們收到一件關於送錯零件的客訴。

general.en: The company will investigate the customer's complaint.
general.zh: 公司將調查客戶的投訴。

general.en: Even a small scratch can lead to a customer complaint.
general.zh: 即使是小刮痕也可能導致客訴。

general.en: It was the first time we had received a customer complaint.
general.zh: 那是我們第一次收到客訴。（過去完成式）

qa.en: Let's draw a fishbone diagram for the exercise bike noise complaint.
qa.zh: 我們針對飛輪車異音客訴畫一張魚骨圖吧。

qa.en: Risk: if the failure mode carries over and the new model sells more, the same defect rate produces more complaints.
qa.zh: 風險：故障模式跟著沿用，新機種又賣得更多，同樣的不良率客訴只會更多。

qa.en: We had eleven field complaints of the same failure mode.
qa.zh: 同一個故障模式我們有十一件市場客訴。

qa.en: The previous model generated eleven field complaints of creaking. Here they are on one chart.
qa.zh: 上一代有十一件異音客訴，我整理在同一張圖上。

qa.en: The FMEA is a living document — it is revised after any design change, process change, or customer complaint, and the revision history is retained.
qa.zh: FMEA 是活的文件，設計改、製程改或有客訴就修訂，改版紀錄都留著。

qa.en: We score severity, occurrence, and detection. High-risk items must have an additional control in the control plan, and the FMEA is reviewed after every customer complaint.
qa.zh: 打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。高風險的項目要在管制計畫追加管制；每次客訴後都要回頭看 FMEA。

general.en: I initiated a comprehensive inspection protocol, personally tested the electronic components, and documented a dimensional discrepancy in the frame.
general.zh: 我啟動了一套完整的檢驗流程，親自測試電子零件，並記錄了車架的尺寸偏差。

qa.en: Check the HS codes of your rubber and belt components against the updated annex — scope is decided by code, not by product name.
qa.zh: 拿橡膠件和皮帶的 HS code 去對更新後的附件 —— 範圍是看 HS code，不是看品名。

qa.en: Are your rubber and belt components in scope of the EUDR?
qa.zh: 你們的橡膠件和皮帶在 EUDR 範圍內嗎？

qa.en: These components are out of scope under the revised annex.
qa.zh: 照修訂後的附件，這些零組件不在範圍內。

qa.en: This sensor performs a safety function, so it is treated as a critical component.
qa.zh: 這個感測器是做安全功能的，所以算關鍵零件。

qa.en: If any component is sourced from a new supplier, do not rely on the old supplier's test report — the new supplier's part needs its own verification.
qa.zh: 如果有零件換了新供應商，不要拿舊供應商的報告來用 —— 新供應商的料件要自己驗過。

qa.en: We have identified which of our components fall within the commodity scope and we retain supplier origin records for them. We can supply the data in whatever format your due diligence system requires.
qa.zh: 我們已經確認哪些零組件在範圍內，也留著它們的供應商產地紀錄。你們盡職調查系統要什麼格式，我們都可以配合。

words.definition: the ability to understand something.

general.en: Reading comprehension takes practice.
general.zh: 閱讀理解需要練習。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: I need to compress the file before sending it.
general.zh: 我需要先把檔案壓縮再寄出。

general.en: My phone storage is full, so I need to compress my photos.
general.zh: 答案：compress（壓縮、縮小檔案大小）

general.en: I need to compress the file.
general.zh: 我需要把檔案壓縮。

general.en: I need to compress my photos.
general.zh: 我需要壓縮我的照片。

words.definition: 由法律或規定所要求，必須做的

general.en: Joining NHI is compulsory for all citizens in Taiwan.
general.zh: 在台灣，加入全民健保對所有公民來說都是強制的。

general.en: Required by law or a rule — In Taiwan, joining the National Health Insurance program is compulsory for all citizens.
general.zh: 法律或規定所要求的。（在台灣，所有公民都必須（強制）加入全民健康保險計畫。）

general.en: In Taiwan, most people have National Health Insurance (NHI). Joining it is compulsory for all citizens. Everyone pays a small monthly fee. When they see a doctor, they only pay a small co-pay.
general.zh: 在台灣，大多數人都有全民健康保險（全民健保）。加入全民健保對所有公民來說都是強制的。每個人每個月繳納少量費用。看醫生時，只需要支付小額的部分負擔。

words.translation: 伺服電腦式紙箱抗壓試驗機

words.definition: to give all your attention and effort to one thing
words.lesson: 20260423 The Farmer and the Wise Woman

general.en: The farmer could not concentrate because his house was so noisy.
general.zh: 農夫因為家裡太吵而無法專心。

general.en: The farmer could not concentrate because his house was too noisy.
general.zh: 農夫因為家裡太吵而無法專心。

general.en: I need to concentrate on the quality inspection report today.
general.zh: 我今天需要專心處理品質檢驗報告。

general.en: It is hard to concentrate when you have a bad headache.
general.zh: 頭痛很嚴重時很難集中注意力。

general.en: Please concentrate on your homework instead of using your phone.
general.zh: To focus on something.（concentrate on = focus on）

general.en: Please concentrate on your work and avoid distractions.
general.zh: 請專注在你的工作上，避免分心。

qa.en: We test the bath concentration twice a day and record the result.
qa.zh: 槽液濃度一天測兩次並記錄。

qa.en: The crack initiated at the weld toe, which is where the stress concentrates.
qa.zh: 裂紋是從焊趾起始的，應力集中在那裡。

qa.en: Free acid, total acidity, and accelerator concentration are titrated at the defined frequency, and any out-of-range result triggers an immediate adjustment and a recheck.
qa.zh: 游離酸、總酸度跟促進劑濃度照規定頻率滴定，一超出範圍馬上調，調完再測一次。

words.definition: 對某事的擔心或興趣

general.en: Our customer expressed concern about the quality.
general.zh: 我們的客戶對品質表示擔憂。

general.en: The volunteers showed genuine concern for the families who lost their homes in the flood.
general.zh: 志工們真心關懷那些在水災中失去家園的家庭。

general.en: Our client was concerned about the project delay.
general.zh: 我們的客戶很擔心專案延遲。

general.en: Thank you for your concern.
general.zh: 謝謝你的關心。

general.en: Safety is our main concern.
general.zh: 安全是我們最大的擔心。

general.en: During lunch, Tom tried to negotiate a better price with a supplier. His customer had also expressed concern about product quality. Tom promised to solve the problem effectively.
general.zh: 午餐時，Tom 試著與供應商協商更好的價格。他的客戶也對產品品質表示擔憂。Tom 承諾會有效地解決這個問題。

qa.en: All results are within specification, so this is not a quality concern today. It is a validity concern: the three runs are not three runs of the same process.
qa.zh: 結果全部在規格內，所以今天不是品質問題，是驗證算不算數的問題：這三批不是同一個製程跑出來的。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: Our client was concerned about the project delay.
general.zh: 我們的客戶很擔心專案延遲。

words.translation: 條件的；條件句（文法用語）
words.definition: a grammar term for a sentence that describes what happens if something else happens first

general.en: This lesson is about the first and second conditionals.
general.zh: 這堂課是關於第一與第二條件句。

general.en: The first conditional talks about real possibilities.
general.zh: 第一條件句討論的是真實的可能性。

general.en: The second conditional is used for imaginary situations.
general.zh: 第二條件句用於想像的情況。

general.en: Nice. And notice what you both just did - that's the second conditional.
general.zh: 很好。而且注意你們兩個剛剛做了什麼 - 那就是第二條件句。

general.en: So the second conditional is for imaginary situations, right? Not real ones.
general.zh: 所以第二條件句是用在想像的情況，對吧？不是真實的情況。

general.en: And the first conditional is for a real possibility?
general.zh: 那第一條件句是用在真實的可能性嗎？

qa.en: My proposal is to approve the carry-over conditional on a dedicated durability test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 我的提案是：沿用有條件核准，條件是針對這個故障模式做專門的耐久測試。

words.lesson: 20260730 樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie 閱讀

general.en: An ice cream cone is shaped like a cone.
general.zh: 冰淇淋甜筒是圓錐形的。

words.definition: A feeling of trust in your own abilities.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Plastic surgery can significantly boost a person's confidence.
general.zh: 整形手術可以顯著提升一個人的自信。

general.en: The first couple weeks were rough, but the instructor's feedback after every quiz slowly built her confidence up.
general.zh: 頭幾週很辛苦，但每次小考後講師的回饋慢慢幫她建立了信心。

general.en: Singing in the school choir gave my shy sister a lot more confidence.
general.zh: 參加學校合唱團讓我害羞的妹妹多了很多信心。

general.en: That's fair. But your confidence has grown a lot this year. I've watched it happen.
general.zh: 這說得有理。但你今年的自信成長了很多。我都看在眼裡。

general.en: She has a lot of confidence in herself.
general.zh: 她對自己很有自信。

general.en: The praise boosted my confidence.
general.zh: 這份讚美增強了我的自信。

qa.en: The inspection level is part of the agreed inspection standard; we can tighten it for your product if you require additional confidence.
qa.zh: 檢驗水準是談好的檢驗標準的一部分；你們想要更保險，我們可以針對你們的產品加嚴。

words.definition: sure about your own ability.

general.en: Anita has become more confident after attending the conversation classes.
general.zh: Anita 上完會話課後變得更有自信了。

general.en: A clear timeline reveals real experience. Anyone can sound confident for five minutes.
general.zh: 清楚的時間線能顯露出真正的經驗。任何人都能裝自信五分鐘。

general.en: After some time, Tom felt more confident because he practiced every day.
general.zh: 一段時間後，Tom 感到更有自信了，因為他每天練習。（feel 是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞 confident。）

general.en: In my opinion, plastic surgery can be helpful when used carefully and for the right reasons, but it should not be seen as the only way to feel confident or happy.
general.zh: 在我看來，當整形手術被謹慎使用，並且出於正確的理由時，它是有幫助的，但它不應該被視為獲得自信或幸福的唯一方式。

general.en: Now, I feel more confident. I can identify many words in texts and understand them. I know I will continue to make mistakes, but each mistake is an opportunity to learn. If you practice a little every day, you can make steady progress.
general.zh: 現在，我感覺更有自信了。我能在文章中認出許多單字並理解它們。我知道我會繼續犯錯，但每一次錯誤都是學習的機會。如果你每天練習一點點，你就能穩定進步。

general.en: Now, I feel more confident. I can identify many words in texts, understand their translation, and use them in both formal and informal situations. I know I will continue to make mistakes, but each mistake is an opportunity to learn.
general.zh: 現在，我感覺更有自信了。我能在文章中認出許多單字、了解它們的翻譯，並在正式與非正式場合使用它們。我知道我會繼續犯錯，但每一次錯誤都是學習的機會。（文法解說：both A and B 意思是「A 和 B 兩者都…」。）

qa.en: Runs 2 and 3 used a different configuration from run 1.
qa.zh: 第二、三批的組態跟第一批不一樣。

qa.en: The fixture change means the validation only covers the new configuration.
qa.zh: 夾具換了，這份驗證就只算新組態。

qa.en: I propose one additional run on the current configuration so that we have three consecutive runs of the process we will actually use in production.
qa.zh: 我建議用現在的條件再跑一批，這樣量產真正要用的製程才有連續三批的資料。

qa.en: Action: either add one more run on the current configuration so you have three consecutive runs of the same process, or re-scope the report to the new configuration and state it.
qa.zh: 行動：要嘛用現在的條件再跑一批，湊足同一製程連續三批；要嘛把報告範圍改成新條件，並且寫清楚。

qa.en: The three runs were not produced under the same conditions, so they do not demonstrate a stable process. I would like one additional run on the current configuration before sign-off.
qa.zh: 這三批不是同樣條件做的，所以證明不了製程穩定。簽之前我希望用現在的條件再跑一批。

general.en: Could you confirm that the hotel room includes free breakfast before I pay?
general.zh: 在我付款之前，可以請你確認飯店房間有含免費早餐嗎？

general.en: Inspectors visited the factory on Monday and confirmed the contamination.
general.zh: 稽查人員週一到廠稽查，確認了污染情況。

general.en: Before purchasing the equipment, I need to submit the invoices to my boss to review and confirm them.
general.zh: 購買設備之前，我需要把發票呈交給老闆審核並確認。

general.en: My boss needs to confirm the invoices.
general.zh: 我老闆需要確認這些發票。

general.en: I'm waiting for him to confirm them.
general.zh: wait for someone to V ＝ 等待某人做某事：我在等他確認這些發票。

qa.en: I would like to confirm the details with the process owner before I answer, to make sure the information I give you is accurate.
qa.zh: 我想先跟製程負責人確認細節再回您，確保講的是對的。

qa.en: Please hold the shipment until we confirm the disposition.
qa.zh: 在我們決定怎麼處理之前，先不要出貨。

qa.en: May I confirm your acceptance criteria for this surface?
qa.zh: 想跟您確認一下，這個面的允收標準是什麼？

qa.en: Please confirm whether the attached specification reflects the latest revision.
qa.zh: 請確認一下，附件的規格是不是最新版。

qa.en: If the corrective action is not confirmed by Friday, we will have to put the supplier on hold.
qa.zh: 週五前對策沒確認，我們就會先停掉這家供應商的供貨。

qa.en: The root cause was confirmed by 5-Why analysis, and the corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture.
qa.zh: 根因用 5 Why 確認過，對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品。

general.en: When a concept finally clicked, it was never during an easy moment; it was always after a period of confusion.
general.zh: 每次一個觀念終於『通了』，都不是在輕鬆的時刻，而是總是在一段困惑之後才發生。

general.en: Don't confuse an opinion as a fact.
general.zh: 不要把意見混淆為事實。

general.en: I found the grammar rules confusing.
general.zh: 我發現文法規則很令人困惑。

general.en: We also used public transportation to travel around the city. At first, the train system seemed confusing, but after a day or two, it became much easier. The locals were friendly and helped us when we got lost.
general.zh: 我們也利用大眾運輸工具在城市裡移動。起初，火車系統看起來令人困惑，但一兩天後，它就變得容易多了。當地人非常友善，在我們迷路時伸出援手。

general.en: One common reason is confusion about dates. Many products are labelled "best before", which is about quality, not safety. Food that is past this date is often still perfectly good, but people throw it away because they are worried.
general.zh: 一個常見的原因是對日期的誤解。許多產品標示「best before（最佳風味期限）」，那指的是品質，而不是安全。過了這個日期的食物通常還是完全可以吃，但人們因為擔心而把它丟掉。

words.definition: A cone-shaped hat used by farmers in Asia.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: A conical hat is a kind of farming hat.
general.zh: 斗笠是一種務農用的帽子。

words.definition: A link or relationship between two things or people.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Is there a connection between the two events?
general.zh: 這兩件事有關聯嗎？

general.en: It took the technician an hour to restore the internet connection at our school.
general.zh: 技術人員花了一個小時才恢復我們學校的網路連線。

general.en: Sorry, the connection is not good today.
general.zh: 抱歉，今天連線品質不太好。

general.en: The technician identified a loose connection.
general.zh: 技術員找出了一個鬆脫的接頭。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: The government is considering new rules for short-term rental properties.
general.zh: 政府正在考慮針對短期租賃物件制定新規定。

general.en: Have you ever considered going to live in another country?
general.zh: 你有沒有考慮過搬到別的國家住？

general.en: I considered applying for the job, but in the end I decided against it.
general.zh: 4. 我考慮過應徵那份工作，但最後決定不去。

general.en: 13. I considered ___ (change) jobs, but decided to stay.
general.zh: 答案：changing（consider + V-ing）

general.en: I considered applying for the job, but I decided against it.
general.zh: 4. 我考慮過應徵那份工作，但決定不去。

general.en: I considered applying for the job.
general.zh: 我考慮過應徵那份工作。

qa.en: Ask the brand in writing which of our part numbers they consider in scope. Do not guess the HS codes ourselves.
qa.zh: 用書面問品牌商：我們哪些料號他們認定在範圍內。HS 編碼不要自己猜。

words.definition: Careful not to trouble other people.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: A considerate person is careful not to inconvenience others.
general.zh: 體貼的人小心不造成他人不便。

words.definition: Happening all the time without stopping.

general.en: He has a constant cough because the air conditioner is too strong.
general.zh: 他一直在咳嗽，因為冷氣太強了。

general.en: Because of her constant effort, the team solved the problems.
general.zh: 因為她持續的努力，團隊解決了問題。

general.en: Cars in Vietnam constantly honk their horns, and the noise affects my sleep.
general.zh: 越南的車經常按喇叭，噪音影響我的睡眠。

general.en: The car horn got stuck, so it kept honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住，所以一直按個不停。

general.en: He is in constant fear.
general.zh: 他處於持續的恐懼中。

general.en: Because of her effective communication and constant effort, the team solved the problems efficiently. They finished the project in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 因為她有效的溝通和持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就完成了專案，並收到了老闆的正面回饋。

qa.en: We cut a 100-square grid, apply the specified tape, and pull it off at a constant angle. The acceptance criterion is class 5B — no squares removed.
qa.zh: 劃 100 格、貼指定膠帶，固定角度撕掉。允收標準 5B，就是一格都不能掉。

words.definition: Happening again and again without stopping.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: Cars in Vietnam constantly honk their horns, and the noise affects my sleep.
general.zh: 越南的車經常按喇叭，噪音影響我的睡眠。

general.en: He is constantly expecting a plane to drop on his head.
general.zh: 他不斷擔心飛機會掉到他頭上。

general.en: Cars in Vietnam constantly honk their horns.
general.zh: 越南的車經常按喇叭。

general.en: Yes. He's the main character, and he's constantly telling everyone that the worst thing will happen.
general.zh: 對。他就是主角，而且他不斷地告訴所有人最糟的事一定會發生。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: The test room is still under construction.
general.zh: 測試室還在施工中。

general.en: Pay attention to sentence construction when you speak.
general.zh: 說話時注意句子結構。（how words are used together in a sentence）

general.en: The construction noise next door has been a real nuisance all week.
general.zh: 隔壁工地的噪音整個禮拜都讓人很煩。

general.en: Our QA office is under construction.
general.zh: 我們的品保辦公室正在施工。

general.en: The building was under construction.
general.zh: 大樓正在施工。

general.en: Last Monday, I had a very busy day at work. Our office building was under construction, so we had to use a different entrance. The elevator was also unreliable, so I had to take the elevator several times and wait for a long time.
general.zh: 上週一，我在公司度過了非常忙碌的一天。我們的辦公大樓正在施工，所以我們得走另一個入口。電梯也很不可靠，所以我得搭好幾次電梯，還等了很久。

words.definition: to go to someone for advice or information; to look up a reference
words.lesson: 20260423 The Farmer and the Wise Woman

general.en: He went to consult the Wise Woman to ask for her advice.
general.zh: 他去請教智者，尋求她的建議。

general.en: She had to consult a doctor about her symptoms.
general.zh: To go to a person for advice.（諮詢專業人士或查工具書）

general.en: When I write business emails, I often consult the dictionary to make sure the grammar is correct.
general.zh: 當我寫商業電子郵件時，我經常查字典以確保文法正確。

general.en: You should consult a doctor before taking this medicine.
general.zh: 你在服用這種藥之前應該先諮詢醫師。

general.en: You should consult a doctor before taking any new supplements.
general.zh: 服用任何新的保健食品之前，你應該先諮詢醫生。

general.en: Before taking the medicine, she consulted a pharmacist.
general.zh: 吃藥之前，她先諮詢了藥師。

words.translation: 聯絡（打電話、傳訊息或找到某人）
words.lesson: 20260908 動名詞與不定詞、壓力用語與辦公室情境

general.en: I was in charge of contacting the IT department.
general.zh: 我負責聯絡資訊部門。

general.en: I usually wear contact lenses and braces at work.
general.zh: 我上班時通常戴著隱形眼鏡和牙套。（搭配：隱形眼鏡 contact lenses、牙套 braces）

general.en: When I arrived at my department, I found out that the computer service was down. I was in charge of contacting the IT department, but the technician denied that there was a serious problem. He said the problem would be fixed soon.
general.zh: 當我到了部門，我發現電腦系統當機了。我負責聯絡資訊部門，但技術人員否認有嚴重的問題。他說問題很快就會修好。

qa.en: Name one point of contact for certificate questions and make sure that person can be reached when the US is awake.
qa.zh: 指定一個證書問題的聯絡窗口，而且美國上班時間找得到人。

qa.en: Name one point of contact who can be reached when the US is awake.
qa.zh: 指定一個美國上班時間找得到的聯絡窗口。

qa.en: If we sell through Amazon, check whether the listing links to our responsible contact, not just a forwarding address.
qa.zh: 如果我們有上 Amazon，確認商品頁連到的是真正的負責聯絡人，不是一個只會轉信的地址。

qa.en: Action: reply to the broker and copy the brand's compliance contact, asking the brand to confirm the citation code. That question belongs to them.
qa.zh: 行動：回信給報關行，副本給品牌商的法規窗口，請品牌商確認 Citation Code。那個問題本來就是他們的。

qa.en: Confirmed and attached: Product ID, Manufacture Date (2026-08-14, taken from the lot traveller), Manufacture Place, Product Test Date, and Point of Contact.
qa.zh: 已確認、附件裡有的：Product ID、製造日期（2026-08-14，從批次流程單抓的）、製造地點、產品測試日期、聯絡窗口。

qa.en: Make sure the marketplace listing links to a real contact — CPSC now names the company, and 'contact us by email' is the only remedy listed here.
qa.zh: 確認平台上的商品頁有連到真正的聯絡人 —— CPSC 會把公司名字公開，這個案例唯一的處理方式是「寄 email 來」。

words.definition: To have something inside.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Please put a fragile label on the box, because it contains cups.
general.zh: 請在箱子上貼易碎標籤，因為裡面裝了杯子。

general.en: If my luggage contains dangerous items, they will inspect it.
general.zh: 如果我的行李裡有危險物品，他們會檢查。

general.en: After testing the product, the operator should attach a label containing the model number, production date, and serial number.
general.zh: 產品測試完後，作業員應貼上標有型號、生產日期和流水號的標籤。

general.en: Each box contains one desiccant pack.
general.zh: 每個箱子裡放一包乾燥劑。

general.en: The box contains glass cups.
general.zh: 這個箱子裝有玻璃杯。

general.en: My luggage contains some liquids.
general.zh: 我的行李裡裝有一些液體。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: Contain first: sort all in-process and in-stock handrail tubes and check for internal rust. Mark and segregate any affected lots.
qa.zh: 先圍堵：在製品跟庫存的扶手管全部翻出來，看裡面有沒有鏽。有問題的批次標起來隔開。

qa.en: We requested submission level 3. The package received contains the part submission warrant and the dimensional report only.
qa.zh: 我們要求的是 Level 3，但收到的只有 PSW 跟尺寸報告。

qa.en: Put the current lot on hold and identify which finished units contain the changed material.
qa.zh: 先把現有批次扣住，清查哪些成品機台已經用到改過的材料。

qa.en: List every purchased item that contains rubber, wood or paper — belts, grips, feet, pallets, cartons — and mark which ones you have a traceable origin for today.
qa.zh: 把買進來有含橡膠、木頭、紙的料全部列出來 —— 皮帶、握把、腳墊、棧板、紙箱 —— 標出哪些今天就追得到產地。

qa.en: We identified an unauthorized change to a customer-approved material. We have contained the affected lots, defined the re-qualification plan, and will review the disposition of in-process units once the comparison data is available.
qa.zh: 我們發現供應商改了客戶承認過的材料，沒經過核准。受影響批次已經圍堵、重新驗證的計畫也定了，比對數據出來後再決定在製品怎麼處理。

words.definition: Something you keep or carry things in.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Workers are checking the containers at the port.
general.zh: 工人正在港口檢查貨櫃。

general.en: There is a disposable container on the back of his motorcycle.
general.zh: 他的機車後面有一個一次性容器。

general.en: If we have any liquids, we need to put them into a small container.
general.zh: 如果我們有任何液體，需要把它們放進一個小容器裡。

general.en: Hot food softens the plastic container.
general.zh: 熱食會使塑膠容器變軟。

general.en: He found a container of pasta.
general.zh: 他看見一盒義大利麵容器（保鮮盒）。

general.en: Put the liquids into a small container.
general.zh: 把液體放進小容器裡。

qa.en: Hi Daniel, attached are the certificate data elements for container TW-2609-118, which closes at 08:00 tomorrow our time.
