qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: What is the root cause, and when can you send us the 8D report?
qa.zh: 根本原因是什麼？8D 報告什麼時候可以給我們？

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

qa.en: Could you provide the root cause analysis and corrective action by Friday?
qa.zh: 根因分析跟對策，週五前給我們。

qa.en: The root cause analysis stops at the operator level, which is not acceptable.
qa.zh: 根因分析停在人員這一層，這樣不能接受。

qa.en: Right, sorry — we're still doing the root cause analysis.
qa.zh: 對，抱歉，我們還在做根本原因分析。

qa.en: The root cause analysis in D4 stops at the operator level. Please continue the why-why analysis to the process level and resubmit by Friday.
qa.zh: D4 的根因分析停在人的層級。請把 why-why 往下做到製程層級，週五前重交。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: The reliability test failed at 60% of the target life. Root cause analysis is in progress, and any design change will require a verification re-test.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試跑到目標壽命 60% 就失效了。根因分析進行中，只要改設計就要重新驗證。

words.definition: a saying used to describe something believed to be the main cause of bad things
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: They also say that money is the root of all evil.
general.zh: 人們也說金錢是萬惡之源。

general.en: They also say that "money is the root of all evil". I think this is so true. Money makes people kill and steal.
general.zh: 人們也說「金錢是萬惡之源」。我認為這非常真實。金錢讓人殺人、偷竊。

general.en: Tom, do you know the expression “money is the root of all evil”?
general.zh: Tom，你知道那句話嗎：「金錢是萬惡之源」？

general.en: Right. So the expression is wrong. Money isn't the root of all evil. It's a mirror.
general.zh: 沒錯。所以那句話是錯的。金錢不是萬惡之源，它是一面鏡子。

general.en: They also say that "money is the root of all evil". I think this is so true.
general.zh: 人們也說「金錢是萬惡之源」。我認為這非常真實。

general.en: Greed is the root of all evil.
general.zh: 貪婪是萬惡之源。

words.translation: 腐爛的 (比 spoiled 嚴重)
words.definition: 已高度腐壞分解，通常有惡臭和霉菌

general.en: The food was rotten — there was green mold on it.
general.zh: 食物已經腐爛，上面長了綠色的黴菌。

general.en: The food was rotten. The sauce had turned sour and there was green mold on the cheese.
general.zh: 食物已經腐壞了。醬汁變酸了，而且起司上長了綠色的黴菌。

general.en: That evening, instead of risking food poisoning, Kevin ordered a hot bowl of soup from a nearby restaurant. It tasted much better than rotten pasta.
general.zh: 那天晚上，為了不冒險導致食物中毒，凱文從附近的餐廳點了一碗熱騰騰的湯。這碗湯的味道比那盒腐爛的義大利麵要好上太多了。（文法：Avoiding the risk... 分詞構句——省略連接詞與相同主詞，使銜接更流暢精煉。）

general.en: The food was rotten.
general.zh: 這盒食物已經腐爛了。

general.en: She also found milk that had expired and cheese that was completely rotten. There was green mold all over it. Some of the vegetables had also spoiled — they were soft and smelled bad.
general.zh: 她還找到了過期的牛奶和已經完全腐爛的起司。上面長滿了綠色的黴菌。一些蔬菜也變質了——它們變軟了且有臭味。

words.definition: a circular table, often used at banquets so guests can share food easily

general.en: The event is usually held in a large restaurant or banquet hall, with round tables and many shared dishes.
general.zh: 活動通常在大型餐廳或宴會廳舉行，使用圓桌，大家一起分享多道菜餚。

general.en: Very lively. The whole company sits at big round tables and shares a set menu.
general.zh: 非常熱鬧。全公司坐在大圓桌旁，一起吃合菜套餐。

general.en: We sat around big round tables to eat.
general.zh: 我們坐在大圓桌旁用餐。

general.en: We sit around big round tables.
general.zh: 我們圍坐在大圓桌旁。

words.lesson: 20260630 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: How much is a round-trip ticket to Munich?
general.zh: 到慕尼黑的來回票多少錢？

words.definition: the usual series of things you do regularly, in the same order, as part of your daily life.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: So Tom's yearly checkup came back with blood pressure that's suddenly 'worth watching' — nothing in his routine had even changed.
general.zh: Tom的年度健檢報告出來，血壓突然變成『值得留意』——他的日常生活根本沒什麼改變。

general.en: Amy's new place is thirty minutes from work, so she flipped her whole morning routine around.
general.zh: Amy 的新家離公司三十分鐘，所以她把整個晨間作息都改了。

general.en: Walking the dog after dinner is part of our family's evening routine.
general.zh: 晚餐後遛狗是我們家晚上的固定流程之一。

general.en: Not a lot, just the usual routine.
general.zh: 沒什麼特別，就是日常作息。

general.en: Daily routines can clash.
general.zh: 日常作息可能會起衝突。

general.en: She has changed her routine because of the longer trip. She gets up at six, not seven. She prepares her clothes and her bag the night before, so she saves time in the morning.
general.zh: 因為通勤變長，她改變了作息。她現在六點起床，而不是七點。她前一天晚上就把衣服和包包準備好，所以早上省下不少時間。

qa.en: The measurement system is validated by a Gage R&R study before the characteristic is released for routine inspection.
qa.zh: 這個特性排進例行檢驗之前，先用 GR&R 把量測系統驗過。

qa.en: Calipers, micrometers, height gauges, feeler gauges, and thread gauges used for routine in-process checks.
qa.zh: 卡尺、分厘卡、高度規、厚薄規、螺紋規這些，製程中例行檢查用的量具。

qa.en: Routine testing is performed in-house; certification testing is performed by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內做，認證測試送有認證的實驗室。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

words.definition: to have a body temperature that is higher than normal because you are sick.
words.lesson: 20260310 英文八大時態與健康症狀 Tenses & Symptoms

general.en: The manager is running a high fever right now.
general.zh: 經理現在正發著高燒。

words.definition: when liquid comes out of your nose.

general.en: I've got a headache, a running nose and a cough.
general.zh: 我頭痛、流鼻水又咳嗽。

qa.en: The runout of this shaft is 0.02 mm, within specification.
qa.zh: 這根軸的偏擺是 0.02 mm，在規格內。

qa.en: Check the shaft runout on the runout tester.
qa.zh: 在偏擺檢測儀上檢查軸的偏擺。

qa.en: The total indicator runout is 0.02 mm.
qa.zh: 總偏擺量為 0.02 mm。

words.lesson: 20260317 現在簡單式 現在進行式

general.en: Till then? Check the app before you head out and give yourself extra time at rush hour.
general.zh: 在那之前呢？出門前先查 App，尖峰時段多留點時間。

general.en: Try to avoid driving downtown during rush hour.
general.zh: 尖峰時段盡量不要開車進市區。

general.en: I guess we should just allow extra time during rush hour.
general.zh: 看來我們尖峰時段就是要多留一點時間。

general.en: It's better to avoid travelling during the rush hour.
general.zh: 7. 最好避免在尖峰時間移動。

general.en: Last year, I moved to a very crowded neighborhood in the city. The population is large, and the streets are always full of cars, especially during rush hour.
general.zh: 去年，我搬到了市裡一個非常擁擠的社區。這裡人口眾多，街道上總是擠滿了車，尤其是在交通尖峰時間。

general.en: Use key words from the passage ("rush hour", "negative thoughts", "suggested", "improve communication skill"); keep the main points and sequence of events; recall from memory instead of reading the text aloud.
general.zh: 摘要時務必使用文章中的關鍵字；保持主要觀點和事件發生的順序（問題背景、收到的建議、決定、正向結果、學到的技能、結論）；避免照著文本唸，試著從記憶中提取以強化理解與表達。

general.en: Always include a moisture absorber to prevent rust.
general.zh: 一定要放乾燥劑以防生鏽。

qa.en: This coating passes 48 hours of salt spray with no red rust.
qa.zh: 這個塗裝過 48 小時鹽霧，沒有紅鏽。

qa.en: This oil was made for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube it cannot coat every spot, so the tube rusts anyway.
qa.zh: 這支防鏽油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不到的地方，照樣鏽。

qa.en: Contain first: sort all in-process and in-stock handrail tubes and check for internal rust. Mark and segregate any affected lots.
qa.zh: 先圍堵：在製品跟庫存的扶手管全部翻出來，看裡面有沒有鏽。有問題的批次標起來隔開。

qa.en: We run 48 hours for powder-coated parts and 96 hours for e-coated parts. After the test we check for red rust, blistering, and creepage from the scribe line.
qa.zh: 粉體件做 48 小時、電著件做 96 小時。做完看有沒有紅鏽、起泡，還有劃線處鏽有沒有擴出去。

qa.en: This powder coating passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray with no red rust and with creepage from the scribe line under one millimeter, which meets the requirement in the specification.
qa.zh: 這個粉體塗裝過 48 小時中性鹽霧，沒有紅鏽，劃線處擴散小於 1 mm，符合規格。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: The rust-preventive oil we used is not suitable for tube interiors.
qa.zh: 我們用的防鏽油不適合管子內部。

qa.en: This rust-preventive oil is not suitable for tube interiors — we need a VCI-type product that protects surfaces the oil does not touch directly.
qa.zh: 「油不好、換掉」沒有技術依據。講清楚為什麼不適合（外面平面 vs. 管子裡面）、要什麼特性（揮發型，碰不到也能防鏽），供應商才知道推薦什麼產品。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: During our in-process inspection today, we found rust forming on the inner surface of treadmill handrail tubes. The tubes were treated with your general-purpose rust-preventive oil (product code RP-210) after cutting.
qa.zh: 今天巡檢時發現跑步機扶手管裡面開始生鏽。切管後有用你們的通用型防鏽油（料號 RP-210）處理過。

qa.en: Could you recommend a VCI-type rust-preventive oil or a product specifically rated for enclosed cavities? We need the product data sheet and a sample for validation before switching.
qa.zh: 可否推薦 VCI 型（揮發型）防鏽油、或適合管子內部使用的產品？切換前我們需要 TDS 跟樣品來驗證。

general.en: Safety training is required for every new operator.
general.zh: 每位新進作業員都必須接受安全訓練。

general.en: We need to adjust the design to meet foreign safety standards.
general.zh: 我們需要調整設計，以符合國外的安全標準。

general.en: A big reason is the 'best before' label — it's about quality, not safety, but people toss perfectly good food anyway.
general.zh: 一大原因是「最佳賞味期限」——那是品質不是安全問題，但大家還是把好好的食物扔了。

general.en: All employees are expected to attend the safety training.
general.zh: 所有員工都應該參加安全訓練。

general.en: I have finished the safety check.
general.zh: 我已經做完安全檢查了。

general.en: One common reason is confusion about dates. Many products are labelled "best before", which is about quality, not safety. Food that is past this date is often still perfectly good, but people throw it away because they are worried.
general.zh: 一個常見的原因是對日期的誤解。許多產品標示「best before（最佳風味期限）」，那指的是品質，而不是安全。過了這個日期的食物通常還是完全可以吃，但人們因為擔心而把它丟掉。

qa.en: How do you control the tightening torque on safety-critical bolts?
qa.zh: 安全關鍵螺栓的鎖付扭力你們怎麼管控？

qa.en: For safety-critical joints we apply 100% torque audit with traceability to the serial number.
qa.zh: 安全相關的鎖點 100% 驗扭力，追得到產品序號。

qa.en: We test it here, and the safety test is done outside.
qa.zh: 這個我們自己測，安全測試送外面做。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: Ask R&D which product features use AI and whether any of them perform a safety function.
qa.zh: 問研發哪些功能有用 AI，有沒有哪一個是做安全功能的。

qa.en: We are identifying which product features rely on AI and whether any of them perform a safety function under the applicable rules.
qa.zh: 我們正在盤點哪些功能有用 AI，以及照規定看有沒有哪一個算安全功能。

qa.en: This sensor performs a safety function, so it is treated as a critical component.
qa.zh: 這個感測器是做安全功能的，所以算關鍵零件。

qa.en: A Safety Gate alert means your product name is on a government database for all to see.
qa.zh: 被掛上 Safety Gate 通報，代表你的產品名字在政府資料庫上面，誰都看得到。

words.definition: An accelerated corrosion test in which the sample is exposed to a salt fog for a defined number of hours.

qa.en: Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

qa.en: The salt spray test showed blistering at 96 hours.
qa.zh: 鹽霧試驗 96 小時出現起泡。

qa.en: The supplier changed the steel without telling us. We caught it in the salt spray test.
qa.zh: 供應商偷換鋼材沒講，鹽霧試驗的時候抓到了。

qa.en: Which test method and revision was used for this salt spray test?
qa.zh: 這次鹽霧測試用的是哪個方法、哪一版？

qa.en: The plating must pass a 48-hour salt spray test.
qa.zh: 電鍍層必須通過 48 小時鹽霧測試。

qa.en: Salt spray testing is performed on every production lot of coated parts, and the chamber conditions are recorded and retained with the test report.
qa.zh: 塗裝件每批量產都做鹽霧，鹽霧箱的條件也跟報告一起記下來存。

words.definition: tasting of salt; containing a lot of salt

general.en: I took a bite and realized the soup was too salty.
general.zh: 我吃了一口才發現那湯太鹹了。

general.en: The French fries are a bit too salty; I should have asked for less salt.
general.zh: 這薯條有點太鹹了，我剛剛應該要求少鹽的。

general.en: I took a bite and realized it was too salty.
general.zh: 我吃了一口才發現太鹹了。

general.en: We have not received the samples so far.
general.zh: 到目前為止我們還沒收到樣品。

general.en: Exactly. And Taiwan is moving the same way. Companies now want work samples and real tasks, not just certificates.
general.zh: 沒錯。而且台灣也在往同一個方向走。企業現在要的是工作實例和實作任務，不只是證書。

general.en: Please bring the samples to my office.
general.zh: 請把樣品帶到我辦公室來。（朝向說話者）

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: The lot size is 1,200 treadmills, so please pull the sample from three different pallets.
qa.zh: 這批批量是 1,200 台跑步機，請從三個不同棧板抽樣。

qa.en: For a lot of 1,200 units at general inspection level II, the sample size code letter is K.
qa.zh: 批量 1,200 台、一般檢驗水準 II 級，樣本大小代字是 K。

qa.en: Judging a whole lot by inspecting only a sample drawn from it, instead of checking every piece.
qa.zh: 只抽一部分來檢，用抽出來的結果判整批，不是每件都檢。

qa.en: The sample size comes from the lot size and the inspection level; the accept/reject decision comes from the AQL table.
qa.zh: 抽幾件看批量跟檢驗水準；收不收，查 AQL 表。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

words.definition: A letter from the standard table that tells you how many pieces to pull from the lot.

qa.en: For a lot of 1,200 units at general inspection level II, the sample size code letter is K.
qa.zh: 批量 1,200 台、一般檢驗水準 II 級，樣本大小代字是 K。

qa.en: The sample size code letter is derived from the lot size and inspection level per ISO 2859-1 Table 1.
qa.zh: 樣本大小代字是照 ISO 2859-1 表 1，用批量跟檢驗水準查出來的。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: We perform sampling inspection based on the applicable inspection level and AQL requirements.
qa.zh: 我們照適用的檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求做抽檢。

qa.en: Our sampling plan is determined according to the lot size, inspection level, and AQL requirements defined in ISO 2859-1.
qa.zh: 我們的抽樣計畫是照 ISO 2859-1 的批量、檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求來定的。

qa.en: The worst process average defect level that is still treated as acceptable for the purpose of sampling inspection.
qa.zh: 抽檢的時候，製程平均不良率最差還能接受到哪裡，那條線就是 AQL。

qa.en: The AQL defines the acceptance criteria for each defect class in the sampling plan.
qa.zh: AQL 就是抽樣計畫裡每個缺點等級收不收的標準。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

words.definition: Checking only a small sample drawn from a lot instead of inspecting every single piece.

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: We perform sampling inspection based on the applicable inspection level and AQL requirements.
qa.zh: 我們照適用的檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求做抽檢。

qa.en: The worst process average defect level that is still treated as acceptable for the purpose of sampling inspection.
qa.zh: 抽檢的時候，製程平均不良率最差還能接受到哪裡，那條線就是 AQL。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100% inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺栓抽檢，跑步機馬達全檢。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: I sat on the sand and enjoyed watching the sunset.
general.zh: 我坐在沙子上，享受看日落。

general.en: The sand was soft.
general.zh: 沙子很軟。

general.en: On the second day, I went to My Khe Beach. The beach was clean and the sand was soft. I walked along the beach and enjoyed the beautiful sea view. It made me feel relaxed.
general.zh: 第二天，我去了美溪海灘。海灘很乾淨，沙子很軟。我沿著海灘散步、欣賞美麗的海景。這讓我覺得很放鬆。

qa.en: We found a run on the edge. Please sand it and respray.
qa.zh: 邊緣有流掛，請打磨後重噴。

words.definition: 強風挾帶大量沙塵形成的風暴

general.en: The sandstorm will hit the city this afternoon.
general.zh: 沙塵暴今天下午將會襲擊這座城市。

general.en: I wore a mask to protect myself because of the sandstorm.
general.zh: 因為沙塵暴，我戴口罩保護自己。

general.en: There is a strong sandstorm.
general.zh: 有一場強烈的沙塵暴。

general.en: Eating instant noodles late at night is so satisfying.
general.zh: 半夜吃泡麵超滿足的。

general.en: It was simple but satisfying.
general.zh: making you feel pleased（讓你感到愉悅的）

general.en: When I finally took a bite, it was simple but satisfying. It made me full, and I realized that even spoiled days can improve with a little effort. Some foods are perishable, but good habits can last longer than any meal.
general.zh: 當我終於咬下一口時，味道很簡單卻令人滿足。它讓我飽足，而我也體會到，即便是糟糕的（被毀掉的）日子，只要付出一點努力就能好轉。有些食物是易腐壞的，但良好的習慣卻能比任何一餐持續得更久。（文法解說：使役結構 make + 受詞 + 形容詞——full 作受詞補語；spoiled 是 spoil 的過去分詞轉化為形容詞修飾 days。）

words.lesson: 20260910 動名詞與不定詞、樂器與稽核英文

general.en: Jazz musicians often play the saxophone.
general.zh: 爵士樂手經常演奏薩克斯風。

words.definition: make someone feel frightened or worried

general.en: They were scared when the elevator stopped suddenly.
general.zh: 當電梯突然停住時，他們感到害怕。

general.en: A strange sound from the basement scared me.
general.zh: 來自地下室的奇怪聲音嚇到了我。

general.en: She was scared to death during the thunderstorm.
general.zh: 打雷下雨時，她被嚇得要死。

general.en: Don't be scared — the dog is friendly.
general.zh: 不要害怕——那隻狗很友善。

general.en: Thunderstorms always scare me.
general.zh: 雷雨總是嚇到我。

general.en: I am scared of snakes.

words.translation: 感到害怕的 (描述人的感受)
words.definition: feeling frightened — use to describe how a person feels

general.en: She was scared to death during the thunderstorm.
general.zh: 打雷下雨時，她被嚇得要死。

general.en: They were scared when the elevator stopped suddenly.
general.zh: 當電梯突然停住時，他們感到害怕。

general.en: A strange sound from the basement scared me.
general.zh: 來自地下室的奇怪聲音嚇到了我。

general.en: Don't be scared — the dog is friendly.
general.zh: 不要害怕——那隻狗很友善。

general.en: The loud noise scared me.
general.zh: 那個巨大的聲音嚇到我。

general.en: I am scared of snakes.
general.zh: 我很怕蛇。

general.en: She is wearing a colorful scarf.
general.zh: 她圍著一條色彩鮮豔的圍巾。

words.translation: 令人害怕的 (描述事物本身)
words.definition: making someone feel frightened — use to describe things

general.en: The road became scary during the heavy rain.
general.zh: 在大雨期間，這條路變得令人害怕。

general.en: The snake looks scary, but it is completely harmless.
general.zh: 那條蛇看起來很嚇人，但其實完全無害。

general.en: Here's the scary stat: over ninety percent of the severe cases hadn't gotten this year's shot.
general.zh: 嚇人的數據來了：超過九成的重症病例都沒打今年的疫苗。

general.en: No, I haven't. This is actually a bit scary for me.
general.zh: 沒有，這對我來說其實有點可怕。

general.en: It's a bit scary, but at least these problems are being found and reported.
general.zh: 雖然有點嚇人，但至少這些問題有被發現、被報導出來。

general.en: Walking alone at midnight is scary.
general.zh: 半夜一個人走路很可怕。

words.definition: the natural features of an area such as mountains and fields.

general.en: There was beautiful scenery, including rice fields and limestone mountains.
general.zh: 有美麗的風景，包括稻田和石灰岩山。

general.en: She loves the food and the scenery in Italy.
general.zh: 她喜歡義大利的美食和風景。

general.en: There was beautiful scenery, including limestone mountains.
general.zh: 有美麗的風景，包括石灰岩山。

general.en: Really? I would keep working. I'd just move somewhere with better scenery.
general.zh: 真的嗎？我會繼續工作。我只會搬去風景比較好的地方。

general.en: Tam Coc is famous for its beautiful scenery / views.
general.zh: 寧平以美麗的風景聞名。

general.en: I am planning to visit Japan for my next vacation. I really want to enjoy the beautiful scenery and eat delicious local food. It will be a great way to relax after working so hard as an engineer.
general.zh: 我計畫下次去日本度假。我真的很想欣賞美麗的風景和吃當地美食。這會是工程師努力工作後一個很棒的放鬆方式。

general.en: A typhoon often messes up flight schedules.
general.zh: 颱風常常打亂班機時刻表。

general.en: The coach tightened the training schedule before the final.
general.zh: 教練在決賽前把訓練行程收得更緊。

general.en: Our class schedule changes every semester.
general.zh: 我們的課表每學期都會改變。

general.en: Some roommates create a schedule.
general.zh: 有些室友會制定時間表。

general.en: Tom has an important job interview today. The interview starts at ten o'clock, and the office is far from his house. He checks the bus schedule and gets ready quickly.
general.zh: Tom今天有一個很重要的面試。面試十點開始，辦公室離他家很遠。他查了公車時刻表，很快就準備好了。

general.en: At first the change was hard. She felt tired in the afternoon and drank too much coffee. But after two weeks, her body got used to the new schedule.
general.zh: 一開始這個改變很辛苦。她下午覺得累，咖啡也喝太多。但兩個星期之後，身體就習慣了新的時間表。

qa.en: We check the die clearance and sharpen the die on schedule.
qa.zh: 我們會檢查模具間隙，照排程研磨模具。

qa.en: Die maintenance is scheduled by shot count, and burr height is checked at first article and at defined intervals during the run.
qa.zh: 模具保養照沖次排，毛邊高度首件要量，量產中也照規定間隔量。

qa.en: What is the impact on the project schedule if we re-test?
qa.zh: 如果要重測，時程會差多少？

qa.en: We would appreciate your reply by Wednesday, as the production schedule depends on it.
qa.zh: 生產排程要看這個，麻煩週三前回覆。

qa.en: This issue may affect the shipment schedule, so I am raising it now.
qa.zh: 這個問題可能影響出貨，所以我現在就先提出來。

qa.en: Any design change (gusset) restarts the reliability clock: plan the re-test time into the schedule honestly.
qa.zh: 只要改設計（加補強板），可靠度測試就要重新起算：重測的時間要老實排進時程。

qa.en: The re-test adds four weeks of schedule risk.
qa.zh: 重測會多出四週的時程風險。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: I ride a scooter to commute to work every morning.
general.zh: 我每天早上騎機車通勤上班。

general.en: The delivery driver put on a yellow raincoat before getting on his scooter.
general.zh: 外送員騎上機車前先穿上黃色雨衣。

general.en: The scooters are all blown over. / Don't worry, this problem will blow over soon.
general.zh: 機車全部被吹倒了。／別擔心，這個問題很快就會平息。

general.en: I ride a scooter to the office.
general.zh: 我騎機車去辦公室。

general.en: I commute by scooter.
general.zh: 我騎摩托車上下班。

general.en: First, I wake up and get dressed for work. Then, I commute to my company in Taichung by scooter. Finally, I inspect the products and lead my team to ensure everything is perfect.
general.zh: 首先，我起床並換好上班的衣服。接著，我騎機車通勤到台中的公司。最後，我檢查產品並帶領我的團隊確保一切完美。

qa.en: Ask the brand in writing which of our part numbers they consider in scope. Do not guess the HS codes ourselves.
qa.zh: 用書面問品牌商：我們哪些料號他們認定在範圍內。HS 編碼不要自己猜。

qa.en: Confirm by HS code, not by product name, which of your parts are still in scope after the scope revision.
qa.zh: 用 HS code（不是用品名）確認範圍調整後，我們哪些零件還在範圍內。

qa.en: Keep supplier origin records even for parts now out of scope — customers keep asking for them contractually.
qa.zh: 移出範圍的零件，供應商產地紀錄也照樣留著 —— 客戶合約上通常還是會要。

qa.en: Decision: stop shipment before you know the full scope. Bounding the population takes two days; a loaded bar falling takes one second.
qa.zh: 決定：在還不知道完整範圍之前就先停止出貨。圈母體要兩天，槓鈴掉下來只要一秒。

qa.en: Action: either add one more run on the current configuration so you have three consecutive runs of the same process, or re-scope the report to the new configuration and state it.
qa.zh: 行動：要嘛用現在的條件再跑一批，湊足同一製程連續三批；要嘛把報告範圍改成新條件，並且寫清楚。

qa.en: The merger changes the international accreditation body, not the accreditation of individual laboratories. Our laboratory remains accredited to ISO/IEC 17025 and its scope is unchanged.
qa.zh: 這次合併改的是國際認證組織，不是個別實驗室的認證。我們的實驗室還是 ISO/IEC 17025 認證，範圍沒變。

qa.en: Please confirm that this test is inside your laboratory's scope of accreditation.
qa.zh: 請確認這項測試在你們實驗室的認證範圍內。

qa.en: The lab is accredited, but this specific test is outside its scope of accreditation.
qa.zh: 實驗室是有認證的，但這一項測試不在它的認證範圍內。

qa.en: Please confirm that salt spray is inside your lab's scope of accreditation.
qa.zh: 請確認鹽霧測試在你們實驗室的認證範圍內。

qa.en: Could you send us your laboratory's current scope of accreditation?
qa.zh: 可以請你們給我們實驗室現在的認證範圍文件嗎？

qa.en: The laboratory is accredited, but this test method is not within its scope of accreditation, so we cannot accept the report as accredited evidence.
qa.zh: 實驗室是有認證，但這個測試方法不在它的認證範圍內，所以我們沒辦法把報告當認證證據收。

qa.en: The report carries an accreditation mark, but the salt spray method is not listed in the scope of accreditation we retrieved from the accreditation body's website.
qa.zh: 報告上有認證標誌，但我們從認證機構網站查到的認證範圍裡，沒有鹽霧這個方法。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is tagged with a red HOLD tag, moved to the quarantine area, and dispositioned by the MRB as rework, repair, use-as-is (with customer concession), or scrap.
qa.zh: 不合格品貼紅色 HOLD 標籤、移到隔離區，MRB 決定要重工、修理、特採（客戶要同意）還是報廢。

words.lesson: 20260915 工廠稽核與組裝線流程

general.en: Even a small scratch can lead to a customer complaint.
general.zh: 即使是小刮痕也可能導致客訴。

general.en: A small scratch can affect the appearance of the product.
general.zh: 一道小刮痕就可能影響產品的外觀。

general.en: I look at whether it's cosmetic or a functional defect. A small scratch is one thing. A part that stops working is completely different.
general.zh: 我會看它是外觀問題還是功能性缺陷。一道小刮痕是一回事，零件不能運作就完全是另一回事。

general.en: Q: How do you check the appearance of the frame? A: We visually inspect the frame and check for scratches, dents, damage, or other visible defects.
general.zh: 問：你們如何檢查車架外觀？ 答：我們目視檢查車架，查看是否有刮痕、凹痕、損壞或其他可見瑕疵。

qa.en: Ac is 5 and Re is 6, so six scratched frames means we reject the whole lot.
qa.zh: Ac 是 5、Re 是 6，所以出現六件刮傷機架就要拒收整批。

qa.en: The scratches are under the protective film, which is applied before final inspection.
qa.zh: 刮傷在保護膜底下，而保護膜在終檢之前就貼上了。

qa.en: This is basic visual inspection. How did three scratched units get through?
qa.zh: 這是最基本的外觀檢驗，三台刮傷的機台是怎麼放過去的？

qa.en: You are right to ask. The scratches are under the protective film, and the film is applied before final inspection — so the check could not see them. That is a gap in our process, and we own it.
qa.zh: 您問得對。刮傷在保護膜底下，而貼膜在終檢之前——檢驗的時候看不到。這是我們流程的洞，我們承認。

qa.en: Two things: the bezel is now inspected before the film goes on, and the film application itself is being checked as a possible scratch source. The 8D with evidence will reach you within five working days.
qa.zh: 兩件事：儀表框改成貼膜前先驗；貼膜這道工序本身也在查，看是不是刮傷就是它造成的。附證據的 8D 五個工作天內給您。

qa.en: The defect escaped because the detection point was after the film application — the inspection could not physically see it. We have moved the detection point and are verifying whether the film process itself created the scratches.
qa.zh: 不良會流出去，是因為檢出點在貼膜之後——檢驗根本看不到刮傷。我們已經把檢出點往前移，也在確認貼膜這道工序是不是刮傷的來源。

general.en: One screw is missing from the accessory box.
general.zh: 配件盒裡少了一根螺絲。

general.en: Please tighten the screws on the frame before testing.
general.zh: 測試之前請把框架上的螺絲鎖緊。

general.en: The technician tightened the loose screw to fix the noise problem.
general.zh: 技術人員把鬆動的螺絲鎖緊，以解決噪音問題。

general.en: After we tightened the loose screw, the noise disappeared.
general.zh: 把鬆動的螺絲鎖緊後，噪音就消失了。

general.en: Tightening the loose screw fixed the noise problem.
general.zh: 把鬆動的螺絲鎖緊解決了噪音問題。

general.en: The noise stopped after we tightened the loose screw.
general.zh: 我們把鬆動的螺絲鎖緊後，噪音就停止了。

qa.en: A screw slowly loosens from vibration.

general.en: Please seal the box before you put it on the pallet.
general.zh: 請先把箱子封好，再放到棧板上。

general.en: Put a moisture absorber inside the box before sealing it.
general.zh: 封箱之前先在箱子裡放一包吸濕劑。

general.en: The operator puts the accessories into a small cardboard box and seals the box with tape.
general.zh: 作業員先把配件放進小紙箱，並用膠帶封箱。

general.en: Check that all accessories are in the box before sealing.
general.zh: 封箱前確認所有配件都在盒子裡。

general.en: We prepare the accessory box first. Then we prepare the product box. After that, we put the accessory box inside the product box, and finally we seal the box.
general.zh: 我們先準備配件盒，再準備產品箱，接著把配件盒放進產品箱裡，最後封箱。

qa.en: This oil was made for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube it cannot coat every spot, so the tube rusts anyway.
qa.zh: 這支防鏽油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不到的地方，照樣鏽。

qa.en: The problem is not that we forgot to apply oil — the problem is that this oil does not work inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 問題不是忘了上油——是這支油在管子裡面沒有用。

qa.en: Before we switch, I want to validate the new oil on sample tubes — coat them, seal both ends, and check after seventy-two hours.
qa.zh: 換之前我要先拿樣品管驗證——上油、兩頭封起來、放七十二小時再看。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: More of the wrong oil does not fix the problem. This oil is for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube, it does not coat evenly and it does not protect where it does not touch. We need a VCI oil that works by releasing vapor.
qa.zh: 用更多不對的油不會解決問題。這支油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不均勻，碰不到的地方就不會保護。要換 VCI 油，靠揮發出來的成分保護裡面。

qa.en: D5: Re-training does not prevent recurrence for a mixing error. We expect an error-proofing action, such as dedicated bins for each bolt length and a weight count-check before sealing.
qa.zh: D5：混料問題，重新訓練防不了再發。我們要的是防呆對策，例如每種長度的螺栓用專用料盒、封箱前秤重點數。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Seats must be upright for landing.
general.zh: 降落時椅背必須直立。

general.en: She chose a window seat for the view.
general.zh: 她選了靠窗座位欣賞風景。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt.
general.zh: 請繫好安全帶。（t 不發音）

general.en: Nobody likes the middle seat.
general.zh: 沒有人喜歡中間座位。

general.en: Your seat is 24A.
general.zh: 你的座位是 24A。

qa.en: I also checked the seat post.

words.definition: A strap that keeps you safe in your seat.

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Yes, please, and fasten your seat belt. We'll be taking off in about ten minutes.
general.zh: 是的，麻煩您，並且繫好安全帶。我們大約十分鐘後起飛。

general.en: Certainly. I'll bring one once the seat belt sign is off.
general.zh: 沒問題。安全帶指示燈熄滅後我就拿一條給您。

general.en: Try to stay relaxed and keep your seat belt fastened. Many passengers find that listening to music or watching a movie helps.
general.zh: 試著保持放鬆並繫好安全帶。很多乘客發現聽音樂或看電影會有幫助。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt.
general.zh: 請繫上安全帶。

general.en: Please secure the cable with a tie before closing the cover.
general.zh: 蓋上外蓋之前，請用束帶把線材固定好。

general.en: The operator uses a staple gun to secure the cardboard box.
general.zh: 作業員使用釘槍固定紙箱。

general.en: Install the electronic cables and secure them with cable ties. Then, we trim off the excess.
general.zh: 安裝電子線並用束帶固定。然後剪掉多餘的部分。

general.en: First, plastic surgery can significantly boost a person's confidence. When people fix a feature that has always bothered them, they often feel much happier and more secure in themselves.
general.zh: 首先，整形手術可以顯著提升一個人的自信。當人們修復了長久以來困擾他們的特徵時，他們通常會感到更快樂，對自己更有安全感。

general.en: The factory improved its security after the theft last year.
general.zh: 去年失竊之後，工廠加強了保全。

general.en: Neither one wins. You're trading time and depth for access, or security for choice. The real price is never just the bill.
general.zh: 沒有哪邊完勝。你不是用時間深度換可近性，就是用保障換選擇。真正的代價從來不只是帳單。

general.en: Footage from one security camera at the bike shop showed who had taken the red bicycle.
general.zh: 腳踏車行一支監視器拍到的畫面，顯示了是誰牽走那台紅色腳踏車。

general.en: About fifteen minutes on foot after the security check. Have a good flight!
general.zh: 過了安檢之後大約走十五分鐘。祝您旅途愉快！

general.en: The security guard asked the crowd to move aside for the ambulance.
general.zh: 保全人員要求群眾往兩旁移動，讓救護車通過。

general.en: We went through the security check.
general.zh: 我們通過了安檢。

words.definition: Where staff check you and your bags for safety.

general.en: About fifteen minutes on foot after the security check. Have a good flight!
general.zh: 過了安檢之後大約走十五分鐘。祝您旅途愉快！

general.en: We need to pour out any liquids over the limit before the security check.
general.zh: 安檢前，超過規定的液體都要倒掉。（隨身液體通常須裝在 100ml 以下的容器中；pour out = 把液體倒掉；over the limit = 超過限制。）

general.en: We went through the security check.
general.zh: 我們通過了安檢。

general.en: It seems the air is polluted because there are too many vehicles.
general.zh: 看起來空氣很髒，因為路上有太多車輛。

general.en: It may seem like a trivial mistake, but it cost the company a big client.
general.zh: 這看起來像是個小錯誤，但它讓公司失去了一個大客戶。

general.en: It has been a long wait, but it seems the routes are finally starting to catch up with how much people actually travel.
general.zh: 這是一段很長的等待，但看起來航線終於開始跟上人們實際的旅行需求了。

general.en: It seems like it's going to rain soon.
general.zh: 看起來快要下雨了。

general.en: It seems that the typhoon has passed.
general.zh: 看起來颱風已經過去了。

general.en: We also used public transportation to travel around the city. At first, the train system seemed confusing, but after a day or two, it became much easier. The locals were friendly and helped us when we got lost.
general.zh: 我們也利用大眾運輸工具在城市裡移動。起初，火車系統看起來令人困惑，但一兩天後，它就變得容易多了。當地人非常友善，在我們迷路時伸出援手。

words.definition: almost never.

general.en: I seldom get sick.
general.zh: 我很少生病。

words.definition: one of the periods that a school year is divided into.

general.en: Michael is really making an effort with his maths this term.
general.zh: Michael 這學期在數學上真的很努力。

general.en: Our class schedule changes every semester.
general.zh: 我們的課表每學期都會改變。

words.definition: a feeling of satisfaction you get from doing something difficult well.

general.en: Cleaning my room gave me a sense of achievement.
general.zh: 打掃房間給了我成就感。

general.en: This experience gave me a strong sense of achievement.
general.zh: 這次經驗讓我更有成就感。

general.en: My mom made me clean my room because it was messy. I didn't want to at first, but she insisted. Afterward, I felt a sense of achievement. It taught me to be more responsible.
general.zh: 我媽逼我打掃房間，因為太亂了。起初我不想，但她很堅持。之後，我感到一種成就感。這教會我要更負責任。

general.en: Every machine has its own serial number.
general.zh: 每一台機器都有自己的序號。

general.en: After testing the product, the operator should attach a label containing the model number, production date, and serial number.
general.zh: 產品測試完後，作業員應貼上標有型號、生產日期和流水號的標籤。

general.en: After testing, the operator must attach a label showing the model number, production date, and serial number.
general.zh: 測試完後，作業員必須貼上顯示型號、生產日期和流水號的標籤。

qa.en: For safety-critical joints we apply 100% torque audit with traceability to the serial number.
qa.zh: 安全相關的鎖點 100% 驗扭力，追得到產品序號。

qa.en: Thank you for the photos and the affected serial numbers. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
qa.zh: 謝謝您提供照片跟受影響的序號，造成困擾我們很抱歉。

qa.en: Bound the population by serial number before you answer the customer.
qa.zh: 回客戶之前先用序號把母體圈出來。

qa.en: Check that the labelling matches the technical file: model number, batch or serial number, manufacturer name, importer name.
qa.zh: 確認標籤跟技術文件對得起來：型號、批號或序號、製造商名稱、進口商名稱。

qa.en: Check whether your production test records can trace a specific unit back to its test result. A batch record that says 'passed' with no serial number is not evidence.
qa.zh: 確認生產測試紀錄能不能追溯到每一台的測試結果。只寫「通過」沒寫序號的批次紀錄，不算證據。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: They had a serious dispute with their landlord.
general.zh: 他們和房東發生了一場嚴重的爭執。

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered by the insurance.
general.zh: 對於嚴重的疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險給付。

general.en: The hospital is facing a serious shortage of nurses.
general.zh: 這家醫院面臨嚴重的護理人員短缺。

general.en: Most medical costs, especially for serious illnesses or surgeries, are covered by government insurance, so healthcare is relatively affordable.
general.zh: 對於重大疾病或手術，大部分醫療費用由保險支付，因此醫療費用相對便宜。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered. Medical treatment is affordable for almost everyone. Taiwan's healthcare system is seen as one of the best in the world.
general.zh: 對於嚴重疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險支付。幾乎所有人都能負擔得起醫療費用。台灣的醫療體系被認為是全球最好的之一。

qa.en: We list what can go wrong and how serious it is.
qa.zh: 我們列出可能出什麼問題、有多嚴重。

words.definition: a sickness that is very dangerous or difficult to treat.

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered by the insurance.
general.zh: 對於嚴重的疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險給付。

general.en: Most medical costs, especially for serious illnesses or surgeries, are covered by government insurance, so healthcare is relatively affordable.
general.zh: 對於重大疾病或手術，大部分醫療費用由保險支付，因此醫療費用相對便宜。

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered. Medical treatment is affordable for almost everyone. Taiwan's healthcare system is seen as one of the best in the world.
general.zh: 對於嚴重疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險支付。幾乎所有人都能負擔得起醫療費用。台灣的醫療體系被認為是全球最好的之一。

words.lesson: 20260319 過去簡單式 過去進行式

general.en: It's important to set a goal before you start.
general.zh: 在開始之前設定目標是很重要的。

words.definition: a fixed group of dishes that a restaurant offers together for one price

general.en: The restaurant offers a special set menu.
general.zh: 餐廳提供特別的套餐。

general.en: Very lively. The whole company sits at big round tables and shares a set menu.
general.zh: 非常熱鬧。全公司坐在大圓桌旁，一起吃合菜套餐。

words.definition: A problem that delays or stops progress.

general.en: We use mistakes and setbacks as learning experiences.
general.zh: 我們把錯誤與挫折當成學習經驗。

words.definition: an area sheltered from direct sunlight; use 'in the shade' (with 'the')

general.en: I like to stand in the shade when it is hot.
general.zh: 天氣熱的時候我喜歡站在陰涼處。

general.en: Please keep your window shade open during landing.
general.zh: 降落時請保持遮光板打開。

words.definition: to divide something among a group of people so everyone gets a part

general.en: I think if all the world's money was shared out, the world would go round more happily.
general.zh: 我認為如果全世界的錢都被分配出去，世界運轉起來會更快樂。

general.en: Because we never share out anything fairly. A small group holds most of it.
general.zh: 因為我們從來沒有公平地分配過任何東西。一小群人握著大部分的錢。

general.en: So the real question is how we share out what we already have.
general.zh: 所以真正的問題是，我們怎麼分配已經有的東西。

general.en: Let's share out the cake.
general.zh: 我們把蛋糕分一分吧。

words.definition: 用刮鬍刀把鬍子或毛髮刮除乾淨

general.zh: 他每天早上刮鬍子。

words.definition: A place that provides cover or protection from danger or bad weather.

general.en: The gym was used as a shelter during the flood.
general.zh: 體育館在洪水期間被用作避難所。

general.en: Survivors were taken to a nearby shelter.
general.zh: 倖存者被帶到附近的避難所。

general.en: The siren went off, so everyone ran to shelter from the tornado.
general.zh: 警報響了，大家都跑去躲避龍捲風。

general.en: A tornado warning has been issued — let's take shelter immediately.
general.zh: 龍捲風警報已發布——我們立刻去避難吧。

general.en: Anita has gone to the shelter.
general.zh: Anita去避難所了（現在還在那裡）。

general.en: Anita has been to that shelter before.
general.zh: Anita以前去過那個避難所（現在已經回來了）。

general.zh: 連續上了一個月十二小時的班後，她累到倒下了。

general.en: I like this gym because its class times are flexible for people who work night shifts.
general.zh: 我喜歡這間健身房，因為它的課程時間對上夜班的人來說很有彈性。

general.en: A colleague from accounting offered to cover my shift while I attended my cousin's wedding.
general.zh: 會計部的一位同事主動說要在我參加表妹婚禮時幫我代班。

general.en: The hospital launched a nationwide recruitment drive after struggling to fill night-shift positions.
general.zh: 那家醫院的夜班職缺一直補不滿，於是在全國展開徵才活動。

general.en: Something has shifted in how the team approaches testing.
general.zh: 這個團隊處理測試的方式，已經有了轉變。

general.en: Have you ever worked on a night shift?

qa.en: Adhesion is checked on the first article of each color change and once per shift during the run.
qa.zh: 每次換色的首件要測附著力，量產中每班再測一次。

qa.en: Risk: by the time the trend crosses the specification limit you have a whole shift of suspect product, not one hour.
qa.zh: 風險：等趨勢跨過規格界限，你要面對的是一整班的可疑品，不是一小時的量。

qa.en: Then we have lost twenty minutes. If I am right and we wait, we sort a full shift.
qa.zh: 那就損失二十分鐘。但如果我是對的、我們又等下去，要挑的就是一整班的產品。

qa.en: All the points are still OK, but they keep going down. I want to check the torque driver before the next shift.
qa.zh: 點都還在範圍內，但一直往下走。我想在下一班之前先查扭力起子。

qa.en: Both curing temperature and film thickness shift the final color.
qa.zh: 烘烤溫度跟膜厚都會讓最後的顏色跑掉。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。

general.en: Surfers drove to the north shore early, hoping to catch the big swell before noon.
general.zh: 衝浪客一早開車到北岸，希望在中午前趕上大湧浪。

qa.zh: 用蕭氏 A 硬度計檢查橡膠墊。

qa.zh: 熱處理鋼件用洛氏，橡膠跟塑膠件用蕭氏。量三點，記平均。

general.en: He used a shovel to dig a hole in the garden.
general.zh: 他用鏟子在花園裡挖了一個洞。

general.zh: 夏天中午通常有一場陣雨。

general.zh: 蓮蓬頭的水壓很低，讓人很難好好洗個澡。

general.zh: 頭髮和肥皂堵住了淋浴間的排水口，結果水淹滿了浴室地板。

general.en: Expect scattered showers in the afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
general.zh: 下午會有零星陣雨，記得帶傘。

general.en: The water pressure in the shower is too low.
general.zh: 淋浴間的水壓太低了。

general.en: After this lesson, I will review the notes we just discussed. Then, I am going to take a hot shower to relax my muscles. Finally, I will go to bed early to prepare for work tomorrow morning.
general.zh: 下課後，我會複習我們剛才討論的筆記。然後，我打算洗個熱水澡放鬆肌肉。最後，我會早點睡覺為明早的工作做準備。

words.definition: To become smaller, often after washing in hot water.

general.zh: 我照著說明洗，但這件襯衫洗第一次就縮水了。

qa.zh: 該區域冷卻後收縮量過大。

general.zh: 請把你的手機調成靜音模式。

words.definition: A fixed basin in a kitchen or bathroom with taps for water.

general.en: The sink fell off the wall because the glue wasn't applied properly.
general.zh: 水槽從牆上掉下來了，因為黏膠沒有塗好。

general.en: We called a plumber because the kitchen sink was blocked.
general.zh: 我們叫了水電工來，因為廚房水槽堵住了。

general.en: My husband still hasn't gotten around to the kitchen — there are dishes in the sink.
general.zh: 我先生還沒空弄廚房——水槽裡還有碗盤。

general.en: The sink was reattached.
general.zh: 洗手台被重新固定。

general.zh: 到了傍晚，所有東西都修好了。磁磚被換新了，水槽被重新固定，天花板也再次變得安全。我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員的辛勤工作。

general.zh: 去年冬天，我廚房水槽下的水管開始漏水。我打電話給一家公司，他們承諾兩天內派人來，但水已經滴到地板上了。我的鄰居聽到聲音，來敲我的門。

qa.en: The sink marks align with the locations of the ribs.

words.definition: 用於戶外公共警示的高頻警報聲

general.en: The siren went off.
general.zh: 警報響了。（Siren 通常指戶外的公共防災警報聲；「響了」用 went off，不是 turns off。）

words.definition: to not do something you usually do.
words.lesson: 20250807 現在進行式與過去進行式

general.zh: 不要在最後一刻翹課。

general.zh: 在家工作的人往往會跳過午餐，或是在筆電前面邊工作邊吃。

general.zh: 我先生在家不吃早餐，都在公司附近隨手買個三明治。

general.zh: 台灣的制度幾乎涵蓋所有人——看病便宜又快，候診室雖擠，但沒人因為錢不敢看醫生。

qa.zh: 我建議折衷，只驗關鍵項目。要完全跳過檢驗，就要主管核准的書面特採。

qa.en: Skip-lot inspection is a defined program, not an ad-hoc decision under schedule pressure.
qa.zh: 跳批檢驗是一套定好的制度，不是被時程逼出來的臨時決定。

words.definition: work that people are forced to do for little or no pay
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more terrible things in the world.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Fair enough. But some companies make loads of money using slave labour. That feels pretty evil to me.
general.zh: 有道理。可是有些公司靠奴工賺了大把的錢。這在我看來就相當邪惡。

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and more terrible things in the world.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: We must stop slave labour.
general.zh: 我們必須停止奴工。

words.definition: to sleep very deeply and not wake up easily

general.en: I was so tired that I slept like a log all night.
general.zh: 我太累了，整晚睡得像木頭一樣沉。

general.en: You should avoid taking sleeping pills every night.
general.zh: 你應該避免每晚都吃安眠藥。

general.en: You're such a smart cookie! You learn so fast.
general.zh: 你真是個聰明的傢伙！你學得好快。

general.en: Don't underestimate him—he's a smart cookie.
general.zh: 別低估他，他很聰明。

general.en: She figured out the answer immediately. She's a smart cookie.
general.zh: 她馬上就想出了答案，真是個聰明的人。

words.definition: without any problems or sudden changes
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: If you don't have money, the world might not go round so smoothly.
general.zh: 如果你沒有錢，世界運轉起來可能就不會那麼順利。

general.en: I hope that in the new year, everything goes smoothly.
general.zh: 我希望新的一年一切順利。

general.en: I hope that in the new year, everything goes smoothly and my English skills continue to improve.
general.zh: 我希望新的一年一切順利，我的英文能力也能繼續進步。

general.en: Life goes gently and smoothly with money.
general.zh: 有錢能讓生活變得溫柔（gently）且順利；沒錢則會讓世界運轉不順暢。

general.en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly.
general.zh: 飛行員平穩地降落了飛機。

general.en: The project is running smoothly.
general.zh: 這個專案進行得很順利。

words.definition: to suddenly push air out through your nose and mouth in a way you cannot control, often because of dust or a cold.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: After a cold, I keep sneezing and my nose is runny.
general.zh: 感冒後，我一直打噴嚏而且流鼻水。

general.en: The colleague sneezes continuously in the office.
general.zh: 同事在辦公室裡連續打噴嚏。（描述他的過敏體質或辦公室目前的常態。）

general.en: The colleague sneezed continuously in the office yesterday.
general.zh: 同事昨天在辦公室裡連續打噴嚏。（明確指出昨天發生的狀況，現在可能戴上口罩或是吃藥好轉了。）

general.en: The colleague will sneeze continuously in the office if the AC is dusty.
general.zh: 如果冷氣很多灰塵，同事在辦公室裡將會連續打噴嚏。（對未來狀況的預測。）

general.en: The colleague is sneezing continuously in the office right now.
general.zh: 同事現在正在辦公室裡連續打噴嚏。（強調此時此刻正在發生的動作，非常有畫面感。）

general.en: The dust in the factory made me sneeze.
general.zh: 工廠裡的灰塵讓我打噴嚏。

words.definition: to make a loud noise through your nose and mouth while sleeping

general.en: I don't snore unless I am extremely exhausted.
general.zh: 除非我極度疲憊，否則我不會打呼。

general.en: My husband snores loudly when he is tired.
general.zh: 我先生累的時候打呼很大聲。

general.en: Unlike my husband, I snore when I am tired.
general.zh: 我不像我先生，我累的時候會打呼。

general.en: Tom tends to snore when he's exhausted.
general.zh: 湯姆精疲力竭時傾向於打呼。

words.definition: 用雪揉捏成的球狀物

general.en: The children made a snowball and threw it at each other.
general.zh: 孩子們做了一顆雪球並互相丟擲。

general.en: The children made snowballs.
general.zh: 孩子們做了雪球。

words.definition: friendly and enjoying being with other people.

general.en: His communication skills are very good. He is a sociable person.
general.zh: 他的溝通能力很好。他是個善於交際的人。

words.definition: A device on a wall that you plug an electrical device into.

general.en: The electrician made sure that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 電工確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

general.en: Thank you. There's one more thing — the socket next to the sink stopped working last week.
general.zh: 謝謝您。還有一件事，洗手台旁邊的插座上星期就不能用了。

general.en: A faulty socket near water isn't safe at all. Please don't use it.
general.zh: 靠近水的插座故障非常不安全，請千萬不要用它。

general.en: I also had some minor repairs done by a carpenter, who repaired a broken door and installed new shelves. An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire, ensuring that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 我也請木匠做了一些小型修繕，他修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。一位電工來修理故障的電線，確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

words.definition: A cold drink with no alcohol.

general.en: Would you like a soft drink?
general.zh: 你想要一杯汽水嗎？

words.definition: a way of solving a problem.

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: Yes, she was. My solution has since been shared with the whole department.
general.zh: 對，她很開心。我的解決方案後來也被分享給了整個部門。

general.en: Implement effective solutions to ensure alignment with our clients' requirements.
general.zh: 落實有效的解決方案，以確保與客戶需求保持一致。

general.en: This is only a temporary solution.
general.zh: 這只是暫時的解決辦法。

general.en: Share personal experiences and concrete solutions: record vocabulary, diversify learning (foreign movies, English articles), and practice speaking every day, even if just a little.
general.zh: 分享個人經驗與具體解決方案：記錄詞彙並每天複習；透過看外語電影、讀英文文章多樣化學習；每天練習口說，即使只是一點點。

qa.en: We expect an error-proofing solution, not a reminder to be careful.
qa.zh: 我們要的是防呆對策，不是提醒人員小心。

qa.en: Check the total alkalinity of the degreasing solution.
qa.zh: 請檢查脫脂劑的全鹼度濃度。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: Never in public. Accountability means we take responsibility outside and sort out the details inside.
general.zh: 公開場合絕對不行。當責的意思是我們對外承擔責任，細節在內部處理。

qa.en: Action: offer options — a different process, a tolerance query to the customer, or a quotation that includes the sorting cost.
qa.zh: 行動：給幾個選項——換製程、跟客戶問公差能不能放寬、或把挑選成本算進報價。

qa.en: The sorting cost was never included in the quotation.
qa.zh: 挑選的成本從來沒算進報價。

qa.en: The supplier is responsible for the sorting cost.
qa.zh: 挑選費用由供應商負責。

qa.en: There are three ways forward: change the process, query the tolerance, or quote the sorting cost. I recommend querying it first — it is free.
qa.zh: 有三條路：換製程、問客戶公差能不能放寬、或把挑選成本報進去。我建議先問——問不用錢。

words.translation: 酸的 (變質或本身的酸味)
words.definition: having an acidic, sharp taste — also used when food has gone bad

general.en: The milk tasted sour because I forgot to put it in the fridge.
general.zh: 牛奶喝起來酸酸的，因為我忘記放進冰箱。

general.en: The food was rotten. The sauce had turned sour and there was green mold on the cheese.
general.zh: 食物已經腐壞了。醬汁變酸了，而且起司上長了綠色的黴菌。

general.en: I love adding a squeeze of lemon to make the soup taste sour.
general.zh: 我喜歡擠一點檸檬讓湯喝起來酸酸的。

general.en: The sauce had turned sour.
general.zh: 醬汁已經變酸。

qa.en: There is too much spatter around the joint. Please grind it off.
qa.zh: 接合處飛濺太多，請磨掉。

words.translation: 統計製程管制與製程能力
words.definition: Monitoring a process with control charts and expressing how well it fits inside the specification limits.

qa.en: We designated the motor mount torque as a special characteristic.
qa.zh: 我們把馬達座扭力指定為特殊特性。

qa.en: The capability study on the special characteristics is still missing.
qa.zh: 特殊特性的能力研究還缺著。

qa.en: The following are missing: control plan, measurement system analysis, capability study for the designated special characteristics, and the material certificate.
qa.zh: 缺的項目有：管制計畫、MSA、特殊特性的能力研究、還有材證。

words.definition: A meal for special diets, such as vegetarian.

general.en: I ordered a vegetarian special meal.
general.zh: 我預訂了素食特別餐。

general.en: It's ridiculous to change the specifications at the last minute.
general.zh: 在最後一刻才改規格實在很荒謬。

qa.en: The procedure for identifying, segregating, and dispositioning product that does not meet the specification.
qa.zh: 不合規格的東西怎麼標、怎麼隔離、怎麼決定處理方式的程序。

qa.en: The inspection report records the specification, the actual value, and the judgement for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 檢驗報告每個特性都有規格、實測值跟判定。

qa.en: A document listing every characteristic to be controlled, with its specification, measuring method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan.
qa.zh: 把每個要管的特性列出來的文件：規格、怎麼量、抽幾件、多久量一次、出問題怎麼辦。

qa.en: The package of evidence submitted to the customer to prove the process can consistently make parts to specification before mass production is approved.
qa.zh: 量產核准前交給客戶的一整包資料，證明製程能穩定做出合規格的東西。

qa.en: Yes. The control plan lists each characteristic, the specification, the measuring instrument, the sample size and frequency, and the reaction plan when the result is out of specification.
qa.zh: 可以。管制計畫上面有每項特性、規格、用什麼儀器量、抽幾件、多久量一次，還有超規時怎麼處理。

qa.en: Every report shows the specification, the actual value, and the judgement — not just OK/NG. Reports are traceable to the lot number and retained per the document control procedure.
qa.zh: 每份報告都有規格、實測值跟判定，不是只寫 OK／NG。報告追得到批號，照文件管制程序保存。

qa.en: We hold a specification review before sales signs anything.
qa.zh: 業務簽任何東西之前，我們都先做規格審查。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: It's ridiculous to change the specifications at the last minute.
general.zh: 在最後一刻才改規格實在很荒謬。

qa.en: We inspect every lot according to your specifications.
qa.zh: 我們依照貴公司的規格檢驗每一批產品。

qa.en: We measured three points per part with a calibrated spectrophotometer.
qa.zh: 我們用校正過的分光色差儀，每件量三點。

qa.en: Calibrate the spectrophotometer with the white tile first.
qa.zh: 先用白板校正色差計。

general.en: The boss gave a short speech to thank us.
general.zh: 老闆做了一段簡短的致詞來感謝我們。

general.en: There are often performances, lucky draws, and prize giveaways, and sometimes the boss gives a short speech.
general.zh: 現場常有表演、抽獎和獎品發放，有時老闆也會上台簡單致詞。

general.en: Many students dread giving speeches in front of the whole class, even if they prepare well.
general.zh: 很多學生都害怕在全班面前演講，即使他們準備得很充分。

general.en: Each candidate for class president gave a short speech in front of the whole school.
general.zh: 每位班長候選人都在全校面前發表了簡短演說。

general.en: The boss made a short speech to thank everyone for their hard work.
general.zh: 老闆說了一段簡短的致詞，感謝大家的辛勞。

general.en: The parrot can mimic human speech.
general.zh: 這隻鸚鵡會模仿人類說話。

words.definition: 食物因放置過久而變質損壞

general.en: The food became spoiled after the power went out.
general.zh: 停電之後食物變質了。

general.en: Some of the food inside had probably spoiled.
general.zh: 裡面的某些食物可能已經變質了。

general.en: She felt a wave of nausea after eating the spoiled food.
general.zh: 吃到壞掉的食物後，她感到一陣噁心。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

general.en: The food became spoiled.
general.zh: 食物酸敗了。

general.en: It was a hot summer day when Amy opened her fridge. She found leftovers from two days ago. The rice looked fine, but the fish smelled strange. Fish is a perishable food — it spoils quickly in warm weather.
general.zh: 某個炎熱的夏天，Amy 打開冰箱。她找到了兩天前的剩菜。米飯看起來沒問題，但魚有股怪味。魚是易腐壞的食物——在溫熱的天氣中很快就會壞掉。

words.definition: 食物不再新鮮安全

general.en: Some of the food inside had probably spoiled.
general.zh: 裡面的某些食物可能已經變質了。

general.en: Even spoiled days can improve with a little effort.
general.zh: no longer good/fresh（不再良好／新鮮的）

general.en: The food became spoiled after the power went out.
general.zh: 停電之後食物變質了。

general.en: She felt a wave of nausea after eating the spoiled food.
general.zh: 吃到壞掉的食物後，她感到一陣噁心。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

general.en: She also found milk that had expired and cheese that was completely rotten. There was green mold all over it. Some of the vegetables had also spoiled — they were soft and smelled bad.
general.zh: 她還找到了過期的牛奶和已經完全腐爛的起司。上面長滿了綠色的黴菌。一些蔬菜也變質了——它們變軟了且有臭味。

words.definition: food that has gone bad and is no longer safe or good to eat.
words.lesson: 20260310 英文八大時態與健康症狀 Tenses & Symptoms

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

general.en: She felt a wave of nausea after eating the spoiled food.
general.zh: 吃到壞掉的食物後，她感到一陣噁心。

general.en: After eating spoiled food, I felt nauseous and started vomiting.
general.zh: 吃了壞掉的食物後，我覺得噁心並開始嘔吐。

words.definition: To pay for an event or show to advertise.

general.en: The concert was canceled because of the typhoon, so the sponsor offered refunds.
general.zh: 演唱會因颱風取消，贊助商提供退款。

general.en: The sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

general.en: The brand sponsors the TV show because it wants more exposure.
general.zh: 該品牌贊助電視節目，因為它想要更多曝光。

general.en: Sponsoring the show gave the brand more exposure.
general.zh: 贊助這個節目讓品牌獲得更多曝光。

general.en: The concert was canceled because of the typhoon, so the sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 演唱會因颱風取消，贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

general.en: The brand sponsors the TV show.
general.zh: 該品牌贊助這個電視節目。

qa.en: How many hours of salt spray does this coating pass?
qa.zh: 這個塗裝可以通過幾小時鹽霧？

qa.en: We put the part in the salt spray chamber for 48 hours.
qa.zh: 我們把零件放進鹽霧箱 48 小時。

qa.en: Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

qa.en: This coating passes 48 hours of salt spray with no red rust.
qa.zh: 這個塗裝過 48 小時鹽霧，沒有紅鏽。

qa.en: Salt spray testing is performed on every production lot of coated parts, and the chamber conditions are recorded and retained with the test report.
qa.zh: 塗裝件每批量產都做鹽霧，鹽霧箱的條件也跟報告一起記下來存。

qa.en: This powder coating passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray with no red rust and with creepage from the scribe line under one millimeter, which meets the requirement in the specification.
qa.zh: 這個粉體塗裝過 48 小時中性鹽霧，沒有紅鏽，劃線處擴散小於 1 mm，符合規格。

general.en: Many families bring spring rolls during this festival.
general.zh: 許多家庭在節日期間帶潤餅。

general.en: Eating spring rolls represents a fresh start in spring.
general.zh: stand for something——吃潤餅代表春天的全新開始。

general.en: Spring rolls are made with thin wrappers.

qa.en: Springback made the bending angle 2 degrees off.
qa.zh: 回彈造成折彎角度偏差 2 度。

words.definition: 小雨零星地落下，或灑水的動作

general.en: It is drizzling. / It is sprinkling.
general.zh: 正在下毛毛雨。／正在飄雨。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: We need to adjust the design to meet foreign safety standards.
general.zh: 我們需要調整設計，以符合國外的安全標準。

general.en: The company has maintained the same safety standard for a decade.
general.zh: 這家公司十年來一直維持著同樣的安全標準。

general.en: Inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: …and my task was to ensure that the first production batch met all quality standards before shipment to a key international client.
general.zh: ……我的任務是確保第一批生產的產品在出貨給重要國際客戶前符合所有品質標準。

general.en: It meets quality standards.

qa.en: The AQL levels are agreed with the customer and documented in the inspection standard; any change requires customer approval.
qa.zh: AQL 是跟客戶談好、寫進檢驗標準的，要改要客戶點頭。

qa.en: A letter from the standard table that converts the lot size and inspection level into the number of pieces to be drawn.
qa.zh: 標準表裡的一個英文字母，把「批量＋檢驗水準」換成要抽幾件。

qa.en: Comparing an instrument against a traceable reference standard at a defined interval and recording the result.
qa.zh: 照規定週期，拿儀器跟可追溯的標準件比對，把結果記下來。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

qa.en: The inspection level is part of the agreed inspection standard; we can tighten it for your product if you require additional confidence.
qa.zh: 檢驗水準是談好的檢驗標準的一部分；你們想要更保險，我們可以針對你們的產品加嚴。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

words.definition: Documenting the current best way to do a job so everyone does it the same way.

qa.en: After the trial, please update the standardized work sheet for the squat rack station.
qa.zh: 試做完成後，請更新深蹲架工作站的標準化作業表。

words.translation: 釘槍(把釘書針打進紙板、木頭)

general.en: The operator uses a staple gun to secure the cardboard box.
general.zh: 作業員使用釘槍固定紙箱。

general.en: Be careful when you use the staple gun.
general.zh: 使用釘槍的時候要小心。

general.en: Each operator is responsible for one station on the production line.
general.zh: 每位作業員負責產線上的一個工站。

general.en: Fortunately, a kind stranger helped me find the station.
general.zh: 幸好，一位好心的陌生人幫我找到了車站。

general.en: The bus to the zoo leaves the station at nine o'clock.
general.zh: 開往動物園的公車九點從車站出發。

general.en: Then halfway to the station it hit him — his wallet was still on the kitchen table. He got there at 7:42. Train was gone.
general.zh: 跑到半路他才猛然想到——皮夾還在餐桌上。他 7:42 到月台，車已經走了。

general.en: When he finally left the house, it was already 7:15. He was running to the station when he realized that he had left his wallet on the kitchen table. He turned around and went back.
general.zh: 當他終於離開家時，已經 7 點 15 分了。他正跑向車站時，才發現自己把錢包留在廚房桌上。他轉身回去拿。

general.en: He reached the platform at 7:42. The train was gone. A station worker told him that the next train would leave in fifty minutes. Daniel sat down, took a deep breath, and sent his manager a short message: "I am going to be late. I am sorry."
general.zh: 他 7 點 42 分抵達月台。火車已經開走了。一位站務人員告訴他，下一班車五十分鐘後才發車。Daniel 坐下來，深呼吸，並傳了一則簡短訊息給主管：「我會遲到，很抱歉。」

qa.en: After the trial, please update the standardized work sheet for the squat rack station.
qa.zh: 試做完成後，請更新深蹲架工作站的標準化作業表。

qa.en: Push the why-why: why could the wrong bolt reach the station? Why could the error pass the packing check?
qa.zh: 追 why-why：錯的螺栓為什麼到得了工作站？包裝檢查為什麼擋不住？

qa.en: D4: "Operator carelessness" is a symptom, not a root cause. Please continue the why-why: why was the wrong bolt available at the station, and why did the final check not detect it?
qa.zh: D4：「人員疏忽」是表象，不是根因。請繼續 why-why：錯的螺栓為什麼會出現在工作站？終檢為什麼沒攔下來？

words.definition: Using statistics on real production data to keep a process stable and catch drift early.

general.en: It helps people stay connected to their family and culture.
general.zh: = keep in touch——幫助人們與家人和文化保持聯繫。

general.en: The festival takes place in spring, so some families also enjoy the nice weather and go for a walk in the countryside. It is a meaningful tradition that helps people stay connected to their family and culture.
general.zh: 這個節日發生在春天，所以有些家庭也會享受好天氣，並到鄉下散步。這是一個有意義的傳統，能幫助人們與他們的家人和文化保持聯繫。

words.lesson: 20260312 英語時態、日常生活、服裝相關動詞和口語練習

general.en: The roads are busy, so stay safe!
general.zh: 路上車多，注意安全！

general.en: Great! Stay safe, Tom!
general.zh: 太好了！Tom你要注意安全喔！

general.en: I used to stay up late often, but I don't anymore.
general.zh: 我以前常常熬夜，但現在不再了。

general.en: I used to stay up late every night.
general.zh: 我以前每天晚上都熬夜。

words.definition: to keep your body at a comfortable temperature, especially in cold weather

general.en: Remember to stay warm during cold weather.
general.zh: 天冷時要記得注意保暖。

general.en: Stay warm; the weather is cold today.
general.zh: 注意保暖，今天天氣很冷。

general.en: Wet leaves often stick to my shoes when I walk to school in autumn.
general.zh: 秋天走路上學時，濕葉子常常黏在我的鞋子上。

general.en: When chores are ignored, tension can build quickly, so it's important to set rules early and stick to them.
general.zh: 當家務被忽視時，緊張氣氛會迅速累積，所以儘早制定規則並遵守它們是很重要的。（are ignored 為被動語態；it 為虛主詞；stick to + 名詞 堅持／遵守。）

general.en: Set rules early and stick to them.
general.zh: 儘早制定規則並遵守它們。

words.translation: 貼紙(泛指可黏貼的東西)

general.en: Do not use a sticker instead of the product label.
general.zh: 不要用貼紙代替產品標籤。

qa.en: Excuse me, what is this yellow sticker for?
qa.zh: 不好意思，這個黃色標籤是做什麼的？

qa.en: Got it. And if there's no sticker at all?
qa.zh: 了解。那如果完全沒有標籤呢？

qa.en: Same rule — no sticker, no measuring. Never guess.
qa.zh: 同樣規則：沒有標籤就不能量測，絕對不要用猜的。

qa.en: No sticker, no measuring.
qa.zh: 沒標籤就不能量。（好記的口訣）

general.en: Taiwan summers are usually hot and sticky — T-shirt and shorts weather.
general.zh: 台灣的夏天通常又熱又黏——就是 T 恤短褲的天氣。

general.en: The dough got all sticky and messy, and she almost threw in the towel twice.
general.zh: 麵團黏得一團糟，她差點放棄兩次。

general.en: The air feels sticky or damp.
general.zh: 高濕度在皮膚上引起的觸覺感受，汗水不易蒸發。

general.en: She has already bought all the ingredients: flour, yeast, salt, and sugar. When she began mixing the dough, her hands got sticky and messy. She felt a little frustrated, so she almost gave up twice.
general.zh: 她已經買齊了所有食材：麵粉、酵母、鹽和糖。當她開始揉麵團時，她的手變得又黏又髒。她覺得有點挫折，所以差點放棄了兩次。

words.definition: a pain in the area of your stomach.

general.en: I think I have food poisoning because I have stomach pain and diarrhea.
general.zh: 我覺得我食物中毒了，因為我肚子痛又拉肚子。

general.en: Yes, quite a lot. The stomach pain started after dinner last night.
general.zh: 有，滿嚴重的。肚子痛是昨天晚餐之後開始的。

general.en: Can I take a painkiller for the stomach pain? I have some at home.
general.zh: 我可以吃止痛藥止肚子痛嗎？我家裡有一些。

general.en: Do you have any stomach pain?

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: Go straight and turn right at the corner.
general.zh: 直走，到路口右轉。

general.en: When I arrived in Hanoi, I went straight to work without taking any rest.
general.zh: 我到河內時直接去上班，完全沒有休息。⚠️ went straight 要連著、流暢地唸，不要拆開。

general.en: So the middle ground makes sense — keep it legal, but be straight about the risks, set an age floor, and rein in the ads.
general.zh: 所以中間立場才合理——維持合法，但風險要說清楚、訂年齡下限、廣告要管緊。

general.en: On the third day, I got ready to go back home. I felt tired because when I arrived in Hanoi, I went straight to work without taking any rest. But I really enjoyed the trip and wanted to come back again.
general.zh: 第三天，我準備好要回家了。我覺得很累，因為一抵達河內，我沒休息就直接去上班。但我真的很享受這次旅行，還想再來一次。

qa.en: Design verification was run on the machined samples and passed. The die-cast parts arrived later and went straight into the reliability build, because "the drawing is the same."
qa.zh: DV 用 CNC 樣品做，全部過。壓鑄件比較晚到，因為「圖面一樣」，就直接裝上可靠度測試機。

words.definition: To make something stronger or more solid.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: Hot pot is a great way to strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 火鍋是增進家庭感情的好方式。

general.en: These events help to strengthen teamwork and morale.
general.zh: 這些活動有助於強化團隊合作與士氣。

general.en: Traditional Taiwanese dishes, like ginger duck or hot pot, are a great way to bring family members together and strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 像薑母鴨或火鍋這樣的台灣傳統料理，是讓家人聚在一起、增進家庭感情的好方式。

general.en: In the corporate world, events serve as crucial milestones for celebrating achievements, fostering team spirit, and strengthening company culture.
general.zh: 在企業世界中，各種活動扮演著重要的里程碑角色，用來慶祝成就、培養團隊精神，以及強化公司文化。

general.en: Milk can strengthen your bones.
general.zh: 牛奶能強化骨骼。

qa.en: We are strengthening our quality culture through regular shop-floor training.
qa.zh: 我們靠定期的現場教育訓練來加強品質文化。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: Anna usually feels stressed at work, but today she feels relieved. Her manager gave her good feedback, so she is happy.
general.zh: Anna 通常在工作時感到壓力很大，但今天她感到如釋重負。她的經理給了她很好的回饋，所以她很高興。

general.en: I felt stressed when I was working next to my boss.
general.zh: 坐在老闆旁邊工作時我覺得很有壓力。（人用 stressed；相反的感受是 calm 或 relaxed）

general.en: She felt stressed out before the exam.
general.zh: 考試前她壓力很大。

general.en: I started to feel stressed.
general.zh: 我開始覺得有壓力。

general.en: I was very stressed.
general.zh: 我壓力很大。

general.en: Later that afternoon, I started to feel stressed. I went outside for a few minutes to feel calm and clear my mind. I tried to imagine myself relaxing on a quiet beach instead of sitting in a busy office.
general.zh: 那天下午稍晚，我開始覺得有壓力。我到外面待了幾分鐘讓自己平靜下來、理清思緒。我試著想像自己在安靜的海灘上放鬆，而不是坐在忙碌的辦公室裡。

words.definition: feeling a lot of stress or anxiety

general.en: I am completely stressed out about the final exam.
general.zh: 我對期末考感到壓力大到快崩潰。

general.en: She felt stressed out before the exam. / This week has been stressful.
general.zh: 考試前她壓力很大。／這一週充滿壓力。

general.en: She felt stressed out before the exam.
general.zh: 考試前她壓力很大。

words.translation: 充滿壓力的（事物的特質）
words.definition: -ing type adjective: describes a situation or event that causes stress

general.en: A friendly workplace can make even a stressful job feel easier to handle.
general.zh: 友善的職場能讓壓力大的工作也感覺比較容易應付。

general.en: Whenever a task at work feels unfamiliar or slightly stressful, I now ask myself a different question.
general.zh: 每當工作上的一項任務讓我覺得陌生或有點有壓力，我現在會問自己一個不一樣的問題。

general.en: I'm okay, but my morning was a little stressful.
general.zh: 我還好，但今天早上有點有壓力。

general.en: This week has been stressful.
general.zh: 這一週充滿壓力。

general.en: By the end of the day, everything was finally back to normal. It had been a stressful and unreliable day, but I was proud that I had handled the problems successfully.
general.zh: 到了一天結束時，一切終於恢復正常。這是充滿壓力、什麼都不可靠的一天，但我很自豪自己成功地處理了這些問題。

general.en: By the end of the day, Tom felt tired but satisfied. "The changes I made today will have lasting effects," he thought. "On the one hand, it was stressful. On the other hand, I made real progress."
general.zh: 到了一天結束時，Tom 感到疲憊但滿足。「我今天所做的改變將會有長期的效果，」他想。「一方面，這很有壓力。另一方面，我取得了真正的進步。」

words.definition: 猛烈地擊中或侵襲某地

general.en: Let's go inside, I think a tornado might hit this area.
general.zh: 我們進去吧，我覺得龍捲風可能會襲擊這一帶。

general.en: Describing storms, the most common verbs are hit, strike, or affect.
general.zh: 描述風暴襲擊最常用 hit、strike 或 affect。（寫作建議：避免用 attack 形容天氣。）

general.en: There is a striking difference between the photos of the park before and after the cleanup.
general.zh: 公園清理前後的照片有著驚人的差異。

words.definition: to try very hard to achieve something difficult.

general.en: I work carefully and always strive to improve product quality.
general.zh: 我做事仔細，並持續努力提升產品品質。

words.definition: 無法移動、前進或解決問題的狀態

general.en: Sometimes I get stuck when I try to speak English.
general.zh: 有時候我嘗試說英文時會卡卡的。

general.en: She got stuck while writing her essay and couldn't continue.
general.zh: 她寫論文時卡關了，無法繼續。

general.en: The car horn is stuck and won't stop honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住了，一直響不停。

general.en: Cars would get stuck in the mud on the road.
general.zh: 車子會卡在路上的泥漿中動彈不得。

general.en: My brain gets stuck when I'm nervous.
general.zh: 當我緊張的時候腦袋會卡住。

general.en: The paper is stuck in the printer.
general.zh: 紙卡在印表機裡了。

words.lesson: 20260821 電腦檔案與辦公室英文

general.en: I created five subfolders in the ABC folder.
general.zh: 我在 ABC 資料夾裡建立了五個子資料夾。

qa.en: The sample submission package includes dimensional, material, and performance evidence plus the process documents.
qa.zh: 樣品承認資料有尺寸、材質、性能的數據，還有製程文件。

qa.en: The warrant is the cover sheet, not the submission.
qa.zh: PSW 只是封面，不等於整份 PPAP。

qa.en: Decision: an incomplete submission is not approved. Record it as interim approval or rejected — never as approved.
qa.zh: 決定：資料不齊就不是核准。只能記暫准或退件，不能記核准。

qa.en: The warrant was signed, but the submission was incomplete.
qa.zh: PSW 簽了，但資料不齊。

qa.en: A typical submission includes the dimensional results, material and performance test reports, the control plan, the PFMEA, the process flow, and the sample parts.
qa.zh: 通常會交尺寸報告、材質跟性能測試報告、管制計畫、PFMEA、製程流程圖，再加樣品。

qa.en: Mass production will not start until we receive your written approval of the submission; any subsequent change requires a new submission.
qa.zh: 你們書面承認之前不會開量產；之後有任何變更都要重新送。

qa.en: We requested submission level 3 for this part.
qa.zh: 這個零件我們要求送件等級 3。

qa.en: We requested submission level 3. The package received contains the part submission warrant and the dimensional report only.
qa.zh: 我們要求的是 Level 3，但收到的只有 PSW 跟尺寸報告。

words.lesson: 20260827 動名詞與不定詞、默契用語與職場英文

general.en: I need to submit the invoices to my boss for review.
general.zh: 我需要把發票交給老闆審核。

general.en: I need to submit the invoices to my boss.
general.zh: 我需要把發票呈交給我老闆。

general.en: Each applicant for the scholarship must submit two letters of recommendation.
general.zh: 每位獎學金申請者都必須繳交兩封推薦信。

general.en: I need to submit my test report to my clients.
general.zh: 我需要把測試報告交給客戶。

general.en: Before purchasing the equipment, I need to submit the invoices.
general.zh: 購買設備之前，我需要呈交發票。

general.en: Before purchasing the equipment, I need to submit the invoices to my boss to review and confirm them.
general.zh: 購買設備之前，我需要把發票呈交給老闆審核並確認。

qa.en: The supplier must submit an 8D report for the cracked squat rack welds within ten working days.
qa.zh: 供應商必須在十個工作天內提出深蹲架焊道龜裂的 8D 報告。

qa.en: What will you submit for our sample approval?
qa.zh: 樣品承認你們會提交什麼？

qa.en: The containment is done. We will submit the full report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵做完了，完整報告週五前給。

qa.en: We will submit the interim report today with the containment evidence, and the full 8D including effectiveness verification by Friday.
qa.zh: 今天先給暫行報告，附圍堵的證據；完整 8D 含效果確認，週五前給。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: A defect that could create a substantial product hazard must be reported immediately.
qa.zh: 可能造成重大產品危害的缺陷，要馬上通報。

words.definition: To achieve something you have been trying to do.

general.en: Most problems can be solved if you keep trying to succeed.
general.zh: 只要持續努力，多數問題都能解決。

general.en: Her determination helped her succeed against all odds.
general.zh: 她的決心幫助她克服一切困難，取得成功。

general.en: success (n.) / succeed (v.) / successful (adj.)
general.zh: 成功（名詞）／成功（動詞）／成功的（形容詞）

general.en: Keep trying to succeed.
general.zh: 持續努力以獲得成功。

words.definition: When something does very well or reaches a good result.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: He never thought the show would be a success.
general.zh: 他從沒想過這部劇會成功。

general.en: Emma always dreamed of achieving success in her career.
general.zh: Emma 一直夢想在事業上取得成功。

general.en: Let's raise our glasses and make a toast to our success.
general.zh: 讓我們舉杯，為我們的成功敬酒。

general.en: Many families eat fish, dumplings, and rice cakes because these foods mean wealth and success.
general.zh: 常見食物有魚、餃子和年糕，象徵財富與成功。

general.en: Emma always dreamed of achieving success in her career. She was a very passionate employee who loved learning new skills and improving herself. Her manager often encouraged her to keep a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 一直夢想在事業上取得成功。她是一位非常有熱忱的員工，熱愛學習新技能和提升自己。她的主管經常鼓勵她保持正面心態，相信自己的能力。

general.en: Later, Emma's manager asked about her experience. She explained that success does not happen by luck. Intelligent people learn from their mistakes, understand the symptoms of problems, and take action before small issues become big ones.
general.zh: 後來，Emma 的主管詢問了她的經驗。她解釋說成功不是靠運氣。聰明的人從錯誤中學習，了解問題的症狀，並在小問題變成大問題之前採取行動。

qa.en: If we cut the sample this week and the penetration theory holds, the earliest re-test completion is week 6 — that leaves two weeks of buffer, assuming a first-pass success.
qa.zh: 如果這週切片、熔深的假設成立，重測最快第 6 週完成——而且要一次過，才剩兩週緩衝。

words.definition: Achieving what you wanted to achieve.

general.en: Farmers are happy when the harvest is successful.
general.zh: 農夫在豐收時會很開心。

general.en: This project has the potential to be very successful.
general.zh: 這個專案有潛力非常成功。

general.en: Good preparation is the key to a successful interview.
general.zh: 充分的準備是面試成功的關鍵。

general.en: The show was very successful.
general.zh: 這部劇非常成功。

general.en: Emma remained an optimist and believed every challenge was an opportunity to grow. Her positive attitude and smart decisions helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 保持樂觀，相信每個挑戰都是成長的機會。她的正面態度和聰明的決定幫助她成為一位成功的領導者。

general.en: Emma remained an optimist, viewing every challenge as an opportunity for growth. Her positive attitude and smart decision-making were the cornerstones that helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 始終保持樂觀，把每個挑戰都視為成長的機會。她正面的態度與聰明的決策，正是幫助她成為一位成功領導者的基石。

words.lesson: 20260903 辦公室難熬的一天與紓壓用語

general.en: My long-term goal is to become a senior quality manager, lead cross-functional teams, and run projects successfully.
general.zh: 我的長期目標是成為資深品管經理，領導跨部門團隊，並成功地完成專案。

general.en: I was proud that I had handled the problems successfully.
general.zh: 我很自豪自己成功地處理了這些問題。

general.en: After sorting out the issues, he successfully connected his device to the TV.
general.zh: 解決問題之後，他成功把裝置連上電視。

general.en: I would like to grow into a senior quality manager, lead cross-functional teams, and ensure that projects are successfully completed.
general.zh: 我希望能成長為資深品管經理，領導跨部門團隊，並確保專案能順利完成。

general.en: I handled the problems successfully.
general.zh: 我成功地處理了問題。

general.en: By the end of the day, everything was finally back to normal. It had been a stressful and unreliable day, but I was proud that I had handled the problems successfully.
general.zh: 到了一天結束時，一切終於恢復正常。這是充滿壓力、什麼都不可靠的一天，但我很自豪自己成功地處理了這些問題。

words.definition: 在沒有預警的情況下迅速發生

general.en: They were scared when the elevator stopped suddenly.
general.zh: 當電梯突然停住時，他們感到害怕。

general.en: My colleague gave me a ride home when it suddenly started pouring.
general.zh: 突然下起大雨時，我的同事開車載我回家。

general.en: So Tom's yearly checkup came back with blood pressure that's suddenly 'worth watching' — nothing in his routine had even changed.
general.zh: Tom的年度健檢報告出來，血壓突然變成『值得留意』——他的日常生活根本沒什麼改變。

general.en: Everything clicked around week five when we got a real work problem — suddenly the formulas actually explained something.
general.zh: 第五週拿到真實工作問題時一切都通了——公式突然真的能解釋現象了。

general.en: The elevator stopped suddenly.
general.zh: 電梯突然停住。

general.en: Lily offered to help, so the two of them worked together in the kitchen. Amy was frying the chicken when the smoke alarm suddenly went off, and both women laughed loudly. The chicken was a little more burnt than usual, but nobody minded.
general.zh: Lily主動說要幫忙，於是兩人一起在廚房裡忙。Amy正在炸雞的時候，煙霧警報器突然響了，兩個人都笑得很大聲。雞肉比平常燒焦了一點，但沒有人介意。

words.lesson: 20260317 現在簡單式 現在進行式

general.en: The GPS suggested an alternative route to avoid the traffic jam.
general.zh: 導航建議走另一條替代路線來避開塞車。

general.en: Such vague expressions can suggest a lack of reflection.
general.zh: 這種含糊的說法可能顯示缺乏反思。

general.en: The pharmacist suggested my grandfather measure his blood pressure every morning before breakfast.
general.zh: 藥師建議我爺爺每天早餐前量一次血壓。

general.en: Could you suggest a good place for a quiet birthday dinner with my parents?
general.zh: 你可以建議一個適合和我爸媽安靜吃生日晚餐的好地方嗎？

general.en: That's rough. Has a new route been suggested?
general.zh: 真慘。有人建議新的路線了嗎？

general.en: Yes, a backup route has been suggested by the transport company.
general.zh: 有，運輸公司建議了一條替代路線。

qa.en: I suggest we judge these lots against Rev B, and set the Rev C cut-in from the next build.
qa.zh: 我建議這幾批照 B 版判，C 版從下一次投產開始切入。

words.definition: red, sore skin caused by too much sun.
words.lesson: 20260728 越南寧平旅遊 Tam Coc Trip

general.en: Use sunscreen to prevent sunburn.
general.zh: 使用防曬乳來防止曬傷。

general.en: He is wearing a black T-shirt and sunglasses.
general.zh: 他穿著黑色 T 恤、戴著太陽眼鏡。

words.definition: light that comes from the sun
